            <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:186px minmax(0,1fr);gap:14px;padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);">
              <span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.5;">Precision on held-out set<span style="display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;font-weight:400;color:#8b8371;margin-top:3px;">0.85 required</span></span>
              <span style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.65;text-wrap:pretty;">Of the answers it gave, how many were right? A model that guesses freely scores well on recall and badly here.</span>
            </div>
            <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:186px minmax(0,1fr);gap:14px;padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);">
              <span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.5;">Calibration check<span style="display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;font-weight:400;color:#8b8371;margin-top:3px;">0.05 max error</span></span>
              <span style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.65;text-wrap:pretty;">When it says it is 90% sure, is it right 90% of the time? Legacy summariser failed here at 0.11 — it grew surer while getting no better.</span>
            </div>
            <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:186px minmax(0,1fr);gap:14px;padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);">
              <span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.5;">Fairness slice review<span style="display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;font-weight:400;color:#8b8371;margin-top:3px;">0.10 max spread</span></span>
              <span style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.65;text-wrap:pretty;">The same question asked across every language, region and customer segment held. The gap between the best and worst slice is the score. swahili-doc-classifier-v1 was refused at 0.16.</span>
            </div>
            <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:186px minmax(0,1fr);gap:14px;padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);">
              <span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.5;">Drift stability<span style="display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;font-weight:400;color:#8b8371;margin-top:3px;">0.75 required</span></span>
              <span style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.65;text-wrap:pretty;">Re-run every month against current material. receipt-classifier-v2 returned 0.68 on Aug 29 and was out of service the same day.</span>
            </div>
            <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:186px minmax(0,1fr);gap:14px;padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);">
              <span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.5;">Explainability sample<span style="display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;font-weight:400;color:#8b8371;margin-top:3px;">95% traced</span></span>
              <span style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.65;text-wrap:pretty;">A sample of answers, each traced back to the source passage behind it. A claim that cannot be traced counts as untraced.</span>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div style="margin-bottom:24px;">
          <div style="font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8b8371;margin-bottom:10px;">Answered from memory, or worked out fresh</div>
          <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.7;text-wrap:pretty;margin-bottom:12px;">Every question is checked against answers already given before it reaches a model. If the same question has been answered and the material behind it has not changed, the stored answer is returned — answered from memory. If not, the model works it out — worked out fresh.</div>
          <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.7;text-wrap:pretty;margin-bottom:12px;">This month 76,400 answers came from memory and 52,000 were worked out fresh. Memory carried 60% of answers on 18% of spend, at a median 0.6s against 5.2s. That gap is the whole reason a memory sits in front of the models.</div>
          <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.7;text-wrap:pretty;">What is stored is the answer and the question that produced it — never source rows. A stored answer is dropped the moment the material behind it changes, which is why the share moves month to month rather than only climbing.</div>
        </div>

        <div style="margin-bottom:24px;">
          <div style="font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8b8371;margin-bottom:10px;">Masking and trust receipts</div>
          <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.7;text-wrap:pretty;margin-bottom:12px;">Identifying fields are replaced with placeholders before a call leaves Nexus Bank, restored on the way back inside the estate, and the placeholder-to-value map is destroyed within milliseconds. Four stages, in that order, every time: de-identified, invoked, re-identified, mapping envelope destroyed.</div>
          <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.7;text-wrap:pretty;margin-bottom:12px;">Each call writes one trust receipt recording that the sequence ran and which pathway it took — Synthesis for a model that composes text, Perception for one that returns a label or a vector. The receipt count always equals the call count: 128,400 calls this month, 128,400 trust receipts. They are the same fact stated two ways, which is why context masked reads 100% and has no trend to show.</div>
          <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.7;text-wrap:pretty;">A receipt carries no field value. It proves the process happened, nothing more — and 100% is a hard line with no exception path, so a figure below it would be a violation, not a variation.</div>
        </div>

        <div style="margin-bottom:24px;">
          <div style="font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8b8371;margin-bottom:10px;">Why models refuse</div>
          <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.7;text-wrap:pretty;margin-bottom:14px;">When a model cannot answer responsibly it declines rather than guesses. There are three reasons, each named after the gate that produced it, and a refusal is written to the trail with that gate. 1,842 answers were refused this month.</div>
          <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:186px minmax(0,1fr);gap:14px;padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);">
            <span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.5;">Not enough proof <span style="color:var(--oxblood);font-weight:600;">(Evidence floor)</span><span style="display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;font-weight:400;color:#8b8371;margin-top:3px;">811 · 44%</span></span>
            <span style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.65;text-wrap:pretty;">It could not find a passage it was allowed to cite. The honest answer is that it does not know — most of these trace to the sparse pre-2019 branch record.</span>
          </div>
          <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:186px minmax(0,1fr);gap:14px;padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);">
            <span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.5;">Not allowed to see it <span style="color:var(--brass);font-weight:600;">(Entitlement)</span><span style="display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;font-weight:400;color:#8b8371;margin-top:3px;">663 · 36%</span></span>
            <span style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.65;text-wrap:pretty;">The asker’s permission does not cover the material the answer would need. The model is not told what it is missing, only that it may not read it.</span>
          </div>
          <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:186px minmax(0,1fr);gap:14px;padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);">
            <span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.5;">Outside what it’s allowed to do <span style="color:#7a8aa3;font-weight:600;">(Scope)</span><span style="display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;font-weight:400;color:#8b8371;margin-top:3px;">368 · 20%</span></span>
            <span style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.65;text-wrap:pretty;">The question falls outside the actor’s own declared purpose — Counterparty Risk Monitor · ACT-1043 asking beyond its declared borrower set accounts for 41 of these.</span>
          </div>
          <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.7;text-wrap:pretty;margin-top:14px;">Refusals are counted as work done, not work lost. Nothing is reclassified after the fact, which is why the three reasons sum to the total exactly.</div>
        </div>

        <div style="border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:16px;">
          <div style="font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8b8371;margin-bottom:10px;">Where it came from</div>
          <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.7;text-wrap:pretty;">These four principles are not view-specific. Every figure in an individual model’s own drawer and every figure in the estate-wide Reading the traffic view is produced by the same six checks, the same memory rule, the same masking sequence and the same three refusal reasons — counted directly from the call and spend log, never sampled and never carried forward.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

  {re:/core bank/i, identity:'Core Banking Database'},
  {re:/ledger|general ledger|\bgl\b/i, identity:'Financial Ledger (GL)'},
  {re:/support ticket|\bticket/i, identity:'Support Ticket Archive'},
  {re:/\bcrm\b/i, identity:'CRM Export'},
  {re:/hr record|hris|\bhr\b/i, identity:'HR Records System'},
  {re:/email|mailbox/i, identity:'Email Archive'}
];
function connectNormalize(s){ return (s||'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9 ]/g,'').replace(/\b(the|a|an|of|and|export|archive|record|records|system|database|log|logs|data)\b/g,'').trim(); }
function connectFindSimilar(name, pool){
  const n = connectNormalize(name); if(!n) return null;
  const nWords = n.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  for(const p of pool){
    const pn = connectNormalize(p); if(!pn) continue;
    if(pn===n) return p;
    const pWords = pn.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    if(nWords.some(w=>w.length>1 && pWords.includes(w))) return p;
  }
  return null;
}

/* Twelve-month trend behind each metric card. Leading nulls are real: a model has no
   figures for months before it entered service, and the chart starts where it started. */
const MR_MONTH_NAMES = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
const mrMonthLabels = (endIdx, endYear) => {
  const out = [];
  for(let k=11;k>=0;k--){ let mi = endIdx-k, y = endYear; while(mi<0){ mi+=12; y-=1; } out.push(MR_MONTH_NAMES[mi]+' '+y); }
  return out;
};

function cloneMsg(m){ return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(m)); }
function stripBranches(m){ const c={...m}; delete c.branches; delete c.branchIndex; return c; }
function startBranchAt(messages, idx, newMsgFields){
  const old = messages[idx];
  const oldTail = messages.slice(idx+1).map(cloneMsg);
  let branches = old.branches ? old.branches.map(b=>({...b})) : [{ msg: stripBranches(old), tail: oldTail }];
  if (old.branches) branches[old.branchIndex] = { ...branches[old.branchIndex], tail: oldTail };
  branches.push({ msg: newMsgFields, tail: [] });
  const branchIndex = branches.length - 1;
  return messages.slice(0, idx).concat([{ ...newMsgFields, branches, branchIndex }]);
}
function switchBranchAt(messages, idx, dir){
  const msg = messages[idx];
  if (!msg.branches) return messages;
  const currentTail = messages.slice(idx+1).map(cloneMsg);
  const branches = msg.branches.map((b,i)=> i===msg.branchIndex ? {...b, tail:currentTail} : b);
  const newIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(branches.length-1, msg.branchIndex + dir));
  const target = branches[newIndex];
  return messages.slice(0, idx).concat([{ ...target.msg, branches, branchIndex:newIndex }], target.tail.map(cloneMsg));
}

function tmBar(pct){ return pct>=75? 'var(--sage)' : pct>=40? 'var(--brass)' : 'var(--oxblood2)'; }
function tmPct(t){ const it=t.items||[]; if(!it.length) return 0; return Math.round(it.filter(i=>i.state==='done').length/it.length*100); }
function tmTagColor(tag){ const h=(tag||'').split(' ')[0];
  if(h==='CHASING'||h==='NOTIFIED') return 'var(--brass)';
  if(h==='MILESTONE'||h==='EVIDENCE') return 'var(--sage)';
  if(h==='METRIC'||h==='BLOCKED') return 'var(--oxblood2)';
  return 'var(--blue)'; }
function tmStatusColor(st){ if(st==='Overdue') return {bg:'rgba(184,57,91,.12)', color:'var(--oxblood2)'}; return statusColors(st); }

function tabStyle(active){ return active? {color:'var(--ink)', border:'var(--ink)'} : {color:'var(--ink3)', border:'transparent'}; }
function statusColors(status){
  if(status==='Uploaded') return {bg:'rgba(91,98,112,.10)', color:'#5b6270'};
  if(status==='In Progress') return {bg:'rgba(22,39,74,.10)', color:'#16274a'};
  if(status==='Committed'||status==='Live'||status==='On track'||status==='Deployed'||status==='Accepted'||status==='Ready to deploy') return {bg:'rgba(29,122,110,.12)', color:'var(--sage)'};
  if(status==='Draft'||status==='In Review'||status==='At risk'||status==='In progress'||status==='Pending approval') return {bg:'rgba(176,141,46,.12)', color:'var(--brass)'};
  if(status==='Rejected'||status==='Not started') return {bg:'rgba(184,57,91,.12)', color:'var(--oxblood2)'};
  return {bg:'var(--surface2)', color:'var(--ink2)'};
}

  _p360Log = React.createRef();
  _akkiLog = React.createRef();
  _docLog = React.createRef();
  _boardLog = React.createRef();
  _shell = React.createRef();
  _measureShell = () => {
    const el = this._shell.current; if(!el) return;
    const h = Math.max(340, Math.round(window.innerHeight - el.getBoundingClientRect().top));
    if(Math.abs((this.state.shellH||0) - h) > 2) this.setState({shellH:h});
  };
  _analyzeLog = React.createRef();
  _tmLog = React.createRef();
  _pin(ref){ const el = ref.current; if(el) el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight; }
  componentDidUpdate(){
    const s = this.state;
    const pKey = (s.p360ChatLog||[]).length+':'+s.p360ChatStep+':'+s.p360ChatBusy;
    if(pKey !== this._p360Key){ this._p360Key = pKey; this._pin(this._p360Log); }
    const aKey = (s.analyzeChatLog||[]).length+':'+s.analyzeChatStep+':'+s.analyzeChatBusy;
    if(aKey !== this._analyzeKey){ this._analyzeKey = aKey; this._pin(this._analyzeLog); }
    const ac = (s.akkiConversations||[]).find(c=>c.id===s.akkiActiveId);
    const acMsgs = ac? ac.messages : [];
    const think = acMsgs.filter(m=>m.respClass==='thinking')[0];
    const kKey = s.akkiActiveId+':'+acMsgs.length+':'+(think? think.shown : 0);
    if(kKey !== this._akkiKey){ this._akkiKey = kKey; this._pin(this._akkiLog); }
    const tmR = s.tmRuns.find(r=>r.id===s.tmSel);
    const tKey = s.tmSel+':'+(tmR? tmR.msgs.length : 0);
    if(tKey !== this._tmKey){ this._tmKey = tKey; this._pin(this._tmLog); }
    const dKey = (s.docChatLog||[]).length+':'+s.docChatStep+':'+s.docChatBusy;
    if(dKey !== this._docKey){ this._docKey = dKey; this._pin(this._docLog); }
    const bKey = (s.boardChatLog||[]).length+':'+s.boardChatStep+':'+s.boardChatBusy;
    if(bKey !== this._boardKey){ this._boardKey = bKey; this._pin(this._boardLog); }
    this._measureShell();
  }
  componentDidMount(){
    this._streamT = setInterval(()=>this.setState(st=>{
      const repRunning = st.reportPrep && st.streamTick < st.reportPrep.startedAt + 10;
      if(st.streamTick >= 34 && !repRunning) return null;
      const t = st.streamTick + 1;
      if(t === 21) return {streamTick:t, analyzeFiles:[{id:'ex-sup', name:'borrower_qualification_set.csv', kind:'extraction', format:'CSV'}, ...st.analyzeFiles]};
      return {streamTick:t};
    }), 1600);
    window.addEventListener('resize', this._onResize);
    window.addEventListener('keydown', this._onDeckKey);
    this._measureShell();
    this._censusT = setInterval(this._censusTick, 1000);
  }
  _onDeckKey = (e) => {
    const s = this.state;
    if(!(s.appOpen==='documents' && s.docDrawerId && !s.docWiz.open && s.drawerTab==='Document')) return;
    const d = s.docs.find(x=>x.id===s.docDrawerId);
    if(!d || d.kind!=='Deck') return;
    const tag = (e.target && e.target.tagName) || '';
    if(tag==='INPUT' || tag==='TEXTAREA' || tag==='SELECT') return;
    if(e.key==='ArrowRight'){ e.preventDefault(); this.deckFlashControls(); this.deckNext(); }
    else if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'){ e.preventDefault(); this.deckFlashControls(); this.deckPrev(); }
  };
  componentWillUnmount(){ clearInterval(this._streamT); clearTimeout(this._toastT); clearTimeout(this._deckT); clearInterval(this._censusT); window.removeEventListener('resize', this._onResize); window.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onDeckKey); }
  _onResize = () => { const w = window.innerWidth; if(Math.abs(w - this.state.winW) > 8) this.setState({winW:w}); this._measureShell(); };
  expandStreamRail = () => this.setState({streamRailExpanded:true});
  hideStreamPanel = () => this.setState({streamRailExpanded:false, streamRevisit:false});
  toggleStreamDetails(id){ return (e) => { if(e && e.stopPropagation) e.stopPropagation();
    this.setState(st=>({streamDetailsOpen:{...st.streamDetailsOpen, [id]: !st.streamDetailsOpen[id]}})); }; }
  openStreamDetail(id){ return () => this.setState({streamOpenId:id}); }
  closeStreamDetail = () => this.setState({streamOpenId:null});
  dismissStreamGroup(id){ return (e) => { if(e && e.stopPropagation) e.stopPropagation();
    this.setState(st=>({streamDismissed:[...st.streamDismissed, id], streamOpenId:null})); }; }
  openStreamRevisit = () => this.setState({streamRevisit:true});
  closeStreamRevisit = () => this.setState({streamRevisit:false});
  ddGoTo(i){ return () => this.setState({ddSlide:i}); }
  ddPrev = () => this.setState(st=>({ddSlide: Math.max(0, st.ddSlide-1)}));
  ddNext = () => this.setState(st=>({ddSlide: Math.min(this.deepDiveSlides().length-1, st.ddSlide+1)}));
  onDdChatChange = (e) => this.setState({ddChatInput:e.target.value});
  onDdChatKeyDown = (e) => { if(e.key==='Enter') this.submitDdChat(); };
  submitDdChat = () => {
    const q = (this.state.ddChatInput||'').trim(); if(!q) return;
    const t = q.toLowerCase();
    let a;
    if(/41%|concentration|critical.path/.test(t)) a = {text:'The 41% is top-two share of critical-path spend, read at July; it peaks at 43% in August and has since fallen to 34%. The figure is a share of spend, not of borrower count \u2014 the two hold that share against 6% of the counterparty list.', slide:3, source:'Q3_counterparty_scorecard.xlsx'};
    else if(/lapse|certif|qualif/.test(t)) a = {text:'Eleven alternates lapsed certification between March and August. Nine share one renewal date, which is why the loss reads as gradual erosion rather than the single administrative event it was.', slide:5, source:'borrower_kyc_certifications.csv'};
    else if(/confiden|weight|cluster/.test(t)) a = {text:'Confidence is highest on certification lapse (84%) because the lapse dates are recorded fact. It is lowest on buyer preference (38%) \u2014 there is no requisition-level data in this set to test it, so the 9% is untested rather than measured.', slide:5, source:'Both sources \u00b7 weighting method'};
    else if(/recover|inflect|correct/.test(t)) a = {text:'Three alternates cleared KYC re-verification in Q3 and a fourth is in review. Top-two share has fallen for four consecutive months, from 43% to 34%. Whether it holds depends on the renewal queue, which is in neither source.', slide:3, source:'borrower_kyc_certifications.csv'};
    else if(/risk|mitigat/.test(t)) a = {text:'The first named risk is that re-qualification is treated as the whole fix. Recertifying alternates restores the list but does not change the renewal cycle that caused nine simultaneous lapses.', slide:9, source:'Derived from both sources'};
    else a = {text:'That is not settled by the two sources in this analysis. What they do support is the headline: the concentration is a certification gap, not a buying preference, and it began correcting in September.', slide:0, source:'Q3_counterparty_scorecard.xlsx \u00b7 borrower_kyc_certifications.csv'};
    this.setState({ddChat:a, ddChatInput:''});
  };
  ddChatGoToSlide = () => { const c=this.state.ddChat; if(c) this.setState({ddSlide: c.slide}); };

    const key = this.qaKeyFor(); const text = (this.state.qaDraft||'').trim();
    if(!key || !text) return;
    const mentions = (text.match(/@[A-Z]\.?\s?[A-Za-z]+/g)||[]).map(m=>m.slice(1).trim());
    const entry = { id:'q'+Date.now(), from:'M. Chen', role:'Compliance', at:'Just now', mentions, text, answers:[] };
    this.setState(st=>({ qaThreads:{...st.qaThreads, [key]:[entry, ...(st.qaThreads[key]||[])]}, qaDraft:'' }));
    this.setToast(mentions.length? ('Question posted \u2014 ' + mentions.join(', ') + ' notified.') : 'Question posted on this document.');
  };

    const x = q.toLowerCase();

      a:'Two critical signals are open. The sharper one: cost-to-serve has been reported flat for three months while the recovery plan reports itself on track \u2014 both submitted by the same function, with no reconciliation attached.',

      cites:['External Audit Report FY25','Management response \u2014 audit points'], effect:'\u2713 Opened the audit report', apply:{doc:'bd3'} };
    if(/question|unanswered|asked|awaiting/.test(x)) return {

  runBoardChat(q){
    if(this.state.boardChatBusy) return;
    this.setState({boardChatInput:'', boardChatBusy:true, boardChatPending:q, boardChatStep:0});
    [600,1200,1800].forEach((ms,i)=> setTimeout(()=>{ if(this.state.boardChatBusy) this.setState({boardChatStep:i+1}); }, ms));
    setTimeout(()=>{
      const r = this.boardAnswer(q);
      this.setState(st=>({ boardChatBusy:false, boardChatPending:'', boardChatStep:0,
        boardChatLog:[...(st.boardChatLog||[]), {q, a:r.a, cites:r.cites, effect:r.effect}] }));
      const ap = r.apply;
      if(ap){
        if(ap.tab) this.setState({boardTab:ap.tab, boardDocOpenId:null});
        if(ap.sev) this.setState({boardSev:ap.sev});
        if(ap.doc) this.setState({boardTab:'docs', boardDocOpenId:ap.doc});
      }
    }, 2300);
  }

  shieldReportData(conv){
    const band = l => ({PUBLIC:'var(--sage)', INTERNAL:'#7a8aa3', CONFIDENTIAL:'var(--blue)', RESTRICTED:'var(--oxblood)'}[l] || 'var(--ink3)');
    const tint = l => ({PUBLIC:'rgba(29,122,110,.12)', INTERNAL:'rgba(122,138,163,.16)', CONFIDENTIAL:'rgba(29,42,90,.10)', RESTRICTED:'rgba(184,57,91,.12)'}[l] || 'var(--surface2)');
    const S = (conv && conv.shieldReport) ? conv.shieldReport : { classification:'PUBLIC', bands:[{label:'PUBLIC',value:0}], categories:[], redacted:0, modelCalls: conv?1:0, models:[{name:(conv&&conv.model)||'Claude Sonnet 5', counterparty:'ANTHROPIC'}], audit:[{event:'chat.created', time:'\u2014'}] };
    const total = S.bands.reduce((a,b)=>a+b.value,0) || 1;
    const CATS = (S.categories&&S.categories.length)? S.categories : [
      {key:'PII',label:'PII',foundLabel:'PII',count:0,items:[]},{key:'BII',label:'BII',foundLabel:'BII',count:0,items:[]},
      {key:'LOC',label:'LOCATIONS',foundLabel:'locations',count:0,items:[]},{key:'PHONE',label:'PHONE NUMBERS',foundLabel:'phone numbers',count:0,items:[]},
      {key:'CARD',label:'CARD NUMBERS',foundLabel:'card numbers',count:0,items:[]},{key:'OTHER',label:'OTHER SENSITIVE',foundLabel:'other sensitive info',count:0,items:[]} ];
    return {
      classification:S.classification, classColor:band(S.classification), classBg:tint(S.classification),
      bands:S.bands.map(b=>({label:String(b.label).charAt(0)+String(b.label).slice(1).toLowerCase(), value:b.value, color:band(b.label), pct:(b.value/total*100), pctLabel:Math.round(b.value/total*100)+'%', countLabel:b.value+' item'+(b.value===1?'':'s')})),
      cats:CATS.map(c=>({ key:c.key, label:(/^(PII|BII)$/.test(c.label)? c.label : String(c.label).charAt(0)+String(c.label).slice(1).toLowerCase()), count:c.count, hasItems:c.count>0,
        foundText:c.count+' '+(c.foundLabel||c.label.toLowerCase())+' found',
        open:this.state.shieldCatOpen===c.key, onToggle:this.shieldToggleCat(c.key),
        arrow:this.state.shieldCatOpen===c.key?'\u25b4':'\u25be', items:(c.items||[]).map(it=>({value:it.value, sent:it.sent})) })),
      redacted:S.redacted, modelCalls:S.modelCalls,
      models:(S.models||[]).map(m=>({name:m.name, counterparty:m.counterparty})),
      audit:(S.audit||[]).map(a=>({event:a.event, time:a.time}))
    };
  }
  akkiOpenArchive = () => this.setState({akkiArchiveOpen:true, akkiArchiveQuery:''});

  akkiCancelPermDelete = () => this.setState({akkiPermDeleteId:null});
  akkiConfirmPermDelete = () => { const id=this.state.akkiPermDeleteId; this.setState(st=>({akkiArchived: st.akkiArchived.filter(a=>a.id!==id), akkiPermDeleteId:null})); };
  akkiToggleModelMenu = () => this.setState(st=>({akkiModelMenuOpen:!st.akkiModelMenuOpen}));
  akkiToggleSettings = () => this.setState(st=>({akkiSettingsOpen:!st.akkiSettingsOpen, akkiModelMenuOpen:false, akkiShieldPanelOpen:false}));
  akkiToggleShieldPanel = () => this.setState(st=>({akkiShieldPanelOpen:!st.akkiShieldPanelOpen, akkiSettingsOpen:false, akkiModelMenuOpen:false}));
  akkiToggleConvRail = () => this.setState(st=>({akkiConvRailOpen:!st.akkiConvRailOpen}));
  akkiSetShield(v){ const id=this.state.akkiActiveId; this.setState(st=>({akkiShield:v, akkiConversations: st.akkiConversations.map(c=> c.id===id? {...c, shield:v}: c)})); }

  finishAnalyzeExport = () => {
    const fmt = this.state.analyzeExportFormat;
    this.setState(st=>({reportPrep:{startedAt:st.streamTick, fmt}}));
    this.setState(st=>({docs:[{id:Date.now(), name:'Counterparty scorecard analysis ('+fmt+')', kind:'Document', status:'Draft', updated:'Just now', body:st.analyzeDeepDiveSynthesis || 'Rapid analysis findings from Q3_counterparty_scorecard.xlsx.'}, ...st.docs]}));
    this.setToast('Exported to Documents as '+fmt+'.');
  };
  akkiToggleThinkHarder = () => this.setState(st=>({akkiThinkHarder:!st.akkiThinkHarder}));
  akkiComposerChange = (e) => this.setState({akkiComposerText:e.target.value});
  akkiComposerKeyDown = (e) => { if(e.key==='Enter' && !e.shiftKey){ e.preventDefault(); this.akkiSend(); } };
  akkiSend = () => { const text = this.state.akkiComposerText.trim(); if(text) this.akkiAsk(text); };
  akkiAsk(text){
    const hit = akkiScriptFor(text);
    const steps = (hit && hit.steps) || AKKI_DEFAULT_STEPS;
    const isNew = !this.state.akkiActiveId;
    const convId = this.state.akkiActiveId || ('c'+Date.now());
    const thinking = { from:'akki', time:'Just now', respClass:'thinking', steps, shown:1 };
    this.setState(st=>{
      let conversations = isNew
        ? [{id:convId, title:text.slice(0,46), model:st.akkiModel, shield:st.akkiShield, lastActive:'Just now', messages:[]}, ...st.akkiConversations]
        : st.akkiConversations;
      conversations = conversations.map(c=> c.id!==convId? c : {...c, lastActive:'Just now', messages:[...c.messages, {from:'user', text, time:'Just now'}, thinking]});
      return { akkiConversations: conversations, akkiActiveId: convId, akkiComposerText:'' };
    });
    this.akkiStream(convId, steps, hit? hit.msg('Just now') : genericMsg('Just now'));
  }
  akkiStream(convId, steps, final){
    if(this._akkiT){ clearInterval(this._akkiT); this._akkiT=null; }
    let i = 1;
    this._akkiT = setInterval(()=>{
      i++;
      if(i > steps.length){
        clearInterval(this._akkiT); this._akkiT = null;
        this.setState(st=>({akkiConversations: st.akkiConversations.map(c=> c.id!==convId? c : {...c, messages: c.messages.map(m=> m.respClass==='thinking'? final : m)})}));
        return;
      }
      this.setState(st=>({akkiConversations: st.akkiConversations.map(c=> c.id!==convId? c : {...c, messages: c.messages.map(m=> m.respClass!=='thinking'? m : {...m, shown:i})})}));
    }, 700);
  }
  askSuggestion(kind){
    const Q = { answered:'How many enterprise contracts do we hold in EMEA that are audit-standard?',
      evidence:'Are our borrowers fully certified for the new audit cycle?',
      permission:'What was the total payroll spend by region last quarter?',
      counterparty:'Where is our counterparty exposure actually concentrated?' }[kind];
    if(Q) return this.akkiAsk(Q);
    let convId = this.state.akkiActiveId;
    this.setState(st=>{
      let conversations = st.akkiConversations;
      if(!convId){ convId='c'+Date.now(); conversations=[{id:convId, title:'New conversation', model:st.akkiModel, shield:st.akkiShield, lastActive:'Just now', messages:[]}, ...conversations]; }
      const pairs = { answered:['How many enterprise contracts do we hold in EMEA that are audit-standard?', answeredMsg('Just now')],
        evidence:['Are our borrowers fully certified for the new audit cycle?', evidenceMsg('Just now')],
        permission:['What was the total payroll spend by region last quarter?', entitlementMsg('Just now')] }[kind];
      conversations = conversations.map(c=> c.id!==convId? c : {...c, messages:[...c.messages, {from:'user', text:pairs[0], time:'Just now'}, pairs[1]]});
      return { akkiConversations:conversations, akkiActiveId:convId };
    });
  }
  askSuggestionAnswered = () => this.askSuggestion('answered');
  askSuggestionEvidence = () => this.askSuggestion('evidence');
  askSuggestionEntitlement = () => this.askSuggestion('permission');
  askSuggestionCounterparty = () => this.askSuggestion('counterparty');
  akkiSetLens(convId, idx, lens){ this.setState(st=>({akkiConversations: st.akkiConversations.map(c=> c.id!==convId? c : {...c, messages: c.messages.map((m,i)=> i!==idx? m : {...m, lens})})})); }
  akkiRefusalAction(convId, idx, note){ this.setState(st=>({akkiConversations: st.akkiConversations.map(c=> c.id!==convId? c : {...c, messages: c.messages.map((m,i)=> i!==idx? m : {...m, actionNote:note})})})); }
  akkiRegenerate(convId, idx){
    this.setState(st=>({akkiConversations: st.akkiConversations.map(c=>{
      if(c.id!==convId) return c;
      const orig = c.messages[idx];
      const alt = { from:'akki', time:'Just now', respClass:orig.respClass, lens:'answer', claimText:orig.claimText, claimHighlight:orig.claimHighlight, claimRest:'(regenerated) '+orig.claimRest, honesty:orig.honesty, reasoningUnits:orig.reasoningUnits, trail:orig.trail, audit:orig.audit };
      return {...c, messages: startBranchAt(c.messages, idx, alt)};
    })}));
  }
  akkiSwitchBranch(convId, idx, dir){ this.setState(st=>({akkiConversations: st.akkiConversations.map(c=> c.id!==convId? c: {...c, messages: switchBranchAt(c.messages, idx, dir)})})); }
  akkiSaveEdit(convId, idx){
    const text = this.state.akkiEditDraft;
    this.setState(st=>({
      akkiConversations: st.akkiConversations.map(c=>{
        if(c.id!==convId) return c;
        let messages = startBranchAt(c.messages, idx, {from:'user', text, time:'Just now'});
        messages = [...messages, genericMsg('Just now')];
        return {...c, messages};
      }),
      akkiEditingIdx:null
    }));
  }
  akkiConversationsView(){
    return this.state.akkiConversations.map(c=>({
      title:c.title, lastActive:c.lastActive,
      bg: c.id===this.state.akkiActiveId? '#fff':'transparent',
      borderColor: c.id===this.state.akkiActiveId? 'var(--blue)':'transparent',
      onSelect: ()=>this.setState({akkiActiveId:c.id, akkiMenuOpenId:null}),
      onMenu: ()=>this.setState(st=>({akkiMenuOpenId: st.akkiMenuOpenId===c.id? null: c.id})),
      menuOpen: this.state.akkiMenuOpenId===c.id,
      onRename: ()=>this.setState({akkiRenamingId:c.id, akkiRenameValue:c.title, akkiMenuOpenId:null}),
      onDelete: ()=>this.setState({akkiDeleteConfirmId:c.id, akkiMenuOpenId:null}),
      isRenaming: this.state.akkiRenamingId===c.id,
      renameValue: this.state.akkiRenamingId===c.id? this.state.akkiRenameValue : c.title,
    }));
  }
  akkiArchiveFiltered(){
    const q=this.state.akkiArchiveQuery.toLowerCase();
    const sort=this.state.akkiArchiveSort;
    let list = this.state.akkiArchived.filter(a=>a.title.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    if(sort==='Most recent') list = list.slice().sort((a,b)=>b.ts-a.ts);
    else if(sort==='Oldest') list = list.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.ts-b.ts);
    else list = list.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.title.localeCompare(b.title));
    return list;
  }
  akkiArchiveSortPick(sort){ return () => this.setState({akkiArchiveSort:sort, akkiArchivePage:1}); }
  akkiArchivePrevPage = () => this.setState(st=>({akkiArchivePage: Math.max(1, st.akkiArchivePage-1)}));
  akkiArchiveNextPage = () => this.setState(st=>{ const max=Math.max(1, Math.ceil(this.akkiArchiveFiltered().length/5)); return {akkiArchivePage: Math.min(max, st.akkiArchivePage+1)}; });
  akkiArchivedView(){
    const page=this.state.akkiArchivePage;
    return this.akkiArchiveFiltered().slice((page-1)*5, page*5).map(a=>({
      title:a.title, archivedAt:a.archivedAt,
      onRestore: ()=>this.setState(st=>({akkiArchived: st.akkiArchived.filter(x=>x.id!==a.id), akkiConversations:[{id:a.id, title:a.title, model:st.akkiModel, shield:'Auto-shield', lastActive:'Just now', messages:[]}, ...st.akkiConversations]})),
      onPermDelete: ()=>this.setState({akkiPermDeleteId:a.id, akkiPermDeleteTitle:a.title}),
    }));
  }
  akkiMessagesView(){
    const conv = this.akkiActiveConv();
    if(!conv) return [];
    return conv.messages.map((m, idx) => {
      const isUser = m.from==='user';
      if(isUser){
        const editing = this.state.akkiEditingIdx===idx;
        const sh = conv.shielded;
        return { isUser:true, text:m.text, time:m.time||'', isEditing:editing, editDraft: editing? this.state.akkiEditDraft : '',
          showShield: !!sh, shieldTitle: sh? ((sh.person||0)+' name, '+(sh.locs||0)+' locations, '+(sh.phone||0)+' phone number masked before this left Nexus Bank') : '',
          showActions: this.state.akkiOpenActionsIdx===idx,
          onToggleActions: ()=>this.setState(st=>({akkiOpenActionsIdx: st.akkiOpenActionsIdx===idx? null : idx})),
          onEditDraftChange: (e)=>this.setState({akkiEditDraft:e.target.value}),
          onCancelEdit: ()=>this.setState({akkiEditingIdx:null}),
          onSaveEdit: ()=>this.akkiSaveEdit(conv.id, idx),
          onCopy: ()=>this.setToast('Copied.'),
          onEdit: ()=>this.setState({akkiEditingIdx:idx, akkiEditDraft:m.text}),
        };
      }
      const isAnswered = m.respClass==='answered', isRefusedEvidence = m.respClass==='refused-evidence', isRefusedEntitlement = m.respClass==='refused-permission', isGenericAnswer = m.respClass==='generic';
      const isThinking = m.respClass==='thinking';
      const shownN = Math.max(1, Math.min(m.shown||1, (m.steps||[]).length));
      const stepsView = isThinking ? (m.steps||[]).slice(0, shownN).map((text,i)=>({ text,
        mark: i < shownN-1 ? '\u2713' : '\u00b7', color: i < shownN-1 ? 'var(--ink3)' : 'var(--ink)' })) : [];
      const auditKey = conv.id+'-'+idx, auditOpen = this.state.akkiAuditOpenKey===auditKey;
      const lens = m.lens || 'overview';
      const lb = (id)=> lens===id? {border:'var(--blue)', bg:'var(--blue)', color:'#fff'} : {border:'var(--line)', bg:'transparent', color:'var(--ink2)'};
      const la=lb('overview'), lr=lb('reasoning'), lt=lb('trail');
      const au = m.audit || {};
      const auditExtract = [
        au.auditId ? (au.auditId + ' \u00b7 ' + (au.purpose||'') + ' \u00b7 2026-08-04T09:02:41Z') : '',
        'SEAM   ingress=internal egress=governed fail_mode=closed',
        'MASK   PERSON_1   rule=NER.person     conf=0.99  chars=11',
        'MASK   PHONE_1    rule=PATTERN.e164   conf=1.00  chars=17',
        'MASK   ADDRESS_1  rule=NER.location   conf=0.97  chars=26',
        'CALL   provider=anthropic model=claude-sonnet-5 tok_in=1842 tok_out=311',
        'SCORE  exposure_reduction=' + ((au.exposure||0)/100).toFixed(2) + ' dilution=' + ((au.dilution||0)/100).toFixed(2),
        'BIND   claim_1 -> unit EMEA-CTR-Q3/214 verbatim=true',
        'GATE   grounding=pass minimum=audit-standard privacy=pass rights=internal-only',
        'RCPT   ' + (au.receiptId||'') + ' sig=ed25519:9f2c\u20264a1b ledger_row=88214 immutable=true'
      ].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
      return { isUser:false, time:m.time||'', isAnswered, isRefusedEvidence, isRefusedEntitlement, isGenericAnswer, isThinking, stepsView, text:m.text,
        onCopy: ()=>this.setToast('Copied.'), onRegenerate: ()=>this.akkiRegenerate(conv.id, idx), onRetry: ()=>this.akkiRetry(conv.id, idx),
        hasOpenDoc: !!m.openDocId, openDocLabel: m.openDocName? ('Open ' + m.openDocName) : '', onOpenDoc: ()=>this.akkiOpenGeneratedDoc(m.openDocId),
        hasBranches: !!(m.branches && m.branches.length>1), branchLabel: m.branches && m.branches.length>1 ? ((m.branchIndex+1)+'/'+m.branches.length) : '',
        onPrevBranch: ()=>this.akkiSwitchBranch(conv.id, idx, -1), onNextBranch: ()=>this.akkiSwitchBranch(conv.id, idx, 1),
        claimText:m.claimText, claimHighlight:m.claimHighlight, claimRest:m.claimRest, honesty:m.honesty,
        memoryTag: (m.reasoningUnits||[]).length>=3 ? '\u00b7 fresh extraction' : '\u00b7 served warm',
        onLensAnswer: ()=>this.akkiSetLens(conv.id, idx, 'overview'), onLensReasoning: ()=>this.akkiSetLens(conv.id, idx, 'reasoning'), onLensTrail: ()=>this.akkiSetLens(conv.id, idx, 'trail'),
        lensIsOverview: lens==='overview', auditExtract,
        lensAnswerBorder:la.border, lensAnswerBg:la.bg, lensAnswerColor:la.color,
        lensReasoningBorder:lr.border, lensReasoningBg:lr.bg, lensReasoningColor:lr.color,
        lensTrailBorder:lt.border, lensTrailBg:lt.bg, lensTrailColor:lt.color,
        lensIsReasoning: lens==='reasoning', reasoningUnits:m.reasoningUnits||[], lensIsTrail: lens==='trail', trail:m.trail,
        onToggleAudit: ()=>this.setState({akkiAuditOpenKey: auditKey, akkiAuditCollapsed:false}), auditCaret: auditOpen? '\u25be':'\u25b8', auditOpen, audit:m.audit||{},
        auditTriggerColor: auditOpen? 'var(--sage)' : 'var(--ink3)',
        auditTriggerLabel: auditOpen? 'Shielding & origin \u2014 showing in audit trail' : 'Shielding & origin \u2014 show in audit trail',
        refusalHeadline:m.refusalHeadline, refusalBody:m.refusalBody, actionNote:m.actionNote,
        onAcceptRecorded: ()=>this.akkiRefusalAction(conv.id, idx, 'Accepted as a recorded statement.'),
        onNarrow: ()=>this.akkiRefusalAction(conv.id, idx, 'Objective narrowed \u2014 ask again with a tighter scope.'),
        onLower: ()=>this.akkiRefusalAction(conv.id, idx, 'Standard lowered for this question only.'),
        onRequestReview: ()=>this.akkiRefusalAction(conv.id, idx, 'Access review requested \u2014 routed to Compliance.'),
      };
    });
  }
  akkiAuditExpand = () => this.setState({akkiAuditCollapsed:false});
  akkiAuditCollapse = () => this.setState({akkiAuditCollapsed:true});
  akkiAuditPanel(){
    const conv=this.akkiActiveConv();
    if(!conv) return {has:false, empty:true, hasShield:false, turnLabel:'No conversation open.'};
    const sh=conv.shielded;
    const shieldSummary = sh? ((sh.person||0)+' name, '+(sh.locs||0)+' locations, '+(sh.phone||0)+' phone number masked before anything left Nexus Bank') : '';
    const views=this.akkiMessagesView();
    let sel=views.findIndex(v=>v.auditOpen && v.isAnswered);
    if(sel<0){ for(let i=views.length-1;i>=0;i--){ if(views[i].isAnswered){ sel=i; break; } } }
    if(sel<0) return {has:false, empty:true, hasShield:!!sh, shieldSummary, turnLabel:conv.title};
    const v=views[sel], au=v.audit||{};
    const turnNo = views.slice(0,sel+1).filter(x=>x.isAnswered).length;
    const auN=(v.reasoningUnits||[]).length;
    const contextLine = auN? ('Context served: '+auN+' of the available source units for this task \u2014 minimal-sufficient, nothing else was disclosed.') : '';
    const custodyLine = auN>=2? ('Assessed as '+auN+' independently-governed items, then re-associated for this one query.') : '';
    const trailLines = String(v.trail||'').split('\n');
    const stepLines = trailLines.filter(l=>/^Step \d+:/i.test(l)).map(l=>l.replace(/^Step \d+:\s*/i,''));
    const rSteps = stepLines.length? stepLines : ['Narrowed the estate to what the question asks about','Kept only the records that qualify, as counted at the last census','Wrote the answer from those records and named what was left out'];
    const rCensus = trailLines.find(l=>/^Census reflected/i.test(l)) || '';
    const rLine1 = auN? ('This answer was built from '+auN+(auN===1?' source':' sources')+' already held in the estate, not from the model\u2019s memory.') : 'This answer was built from records held in the estate, not from the model\u2019s memory.';
    const rLine2 = 'Each source was read as it stood at the last census, then combined only for this one question.';
    const rClosing = 'Every figure in the answer traces back to one of the sources above. Where something was not measured, the answer says so rather than estimating.';
    return { has:true, empty:false, hasShield:!!sh, shieldSummary,
      rLine1, rLine2, rSources:auN, rSteps:rSteps.length, rStepsView:rSteps.map((t,i)=>({key:'s'+i, n:String(i+1), text:t})), rCaveat:v.honesty||'', rCensus, rClosing,
      turnLabel: conv.title + ' \u00b7 answer ' + turnNo,
      onLensOverview:v.onLensAnswer, onLensReasoning:v.onLensReasoning, onLensTrail:v.onLensTrail,
      overviewBorder:v.lensAnswerBorder, overviewBg:v.lensAnswerBg, overviewColor:v.lensAnswerColor,
      reasoningBorder:v.lensReasoningBorder, reasoningBg:v.lensReasoningBg, reasoningColor:v.lensReasoningColor,
      trailBorder:v.lensTrailBorder, trailBg:v.lensTrailBg, trailColor:v.lensTrailColor,
      isOverview:v.lensIsOverview, isReasoning:v.lensIsReasoning, isTrail:v.lensIsTrail,
      reasoningUnits:v.reasoningUnits, extract:v.auditExtract, contextLine, custodyLine,
      line1:au.line1, line2:au.line2, exposure:au.exposure, dilution:au.dilution,
      purpose:au.purpose, auditId:au.auditId, receiptId:au.receiptId, closing:au.closing };
  }

  akkiCloseCreateDocModal = () => this.setState({akkiCreateModalOpen:false});

  akkiCreateModalGenerate = () => {
    const conv = this.akkiActiveConv();
    if(!conv) return;
    const convId = conv.id;
    const cadence = this.state.akkiCreateCadence==='Other'? this.state.akkiCreateCadenceOther : this.state.akkiCreateCadence;
    const docType = this.state.akkiCreateDocType;
    const fmt = this.state.akkiCreateFormat;
    const title = docType + ' \u2014 ' + conv.title;
    const kind = (fmt==='PPTX')? 'Deck':'Document';
    const docId = Date.now();
    this.setState({akkiCreateModalOpen:false});
    this.runDocGenSequence(0, () => {
      const body = 'Prepared ' + (cadence? cadence.toLowerCase() : 'for internal use') + ', from the conversation \u201c' + conv.title + '\u201d.\n\nEvery claim carried over keeps the evidence class it had in the thread. Nothing was added that the conversation did not support.';
      this.setState(st=>({
        docs:[{id:docId, name:title, kind, status:'Draft', updated:'Just now', body, slides:[{title, body}]}, ...st.docs],
        akkiConversations: st.akkiConversations.map(c=> c.id!==convId? c : {...c, messages:[...c.messages, {from:'akki', time:'Just now', respClass:'generic', text:'Your ' + (docType||'document') + ' is ready as ' + fmt + '. It follows the cadence you chose and carries the same evidence classes as this conversation.', openDocId:docId, openDocName:title}]})
      }));
    }, 'chatCreate');
  };

  akkiRetry(convId, idx){
    this.setState(st=>({akkiConversations: st.akkiConversations.map(c=> c.id!==convId? c : {...c, messages: c.messages.map((m,i)=> i!==idx? m : {...m, retried:true, time:'Just now'})})}));
    this.setToast('Retried \u2014 same question, same grounding, fresh pass.');
  }

  rapidClassify(q){
    const s=q.toLowerCase();
    if(/forecast|predict|project|driving|drive/.test(s)) return {tag:'FORECAST', text:'Counterparty concentration risk is projected to ease slightly in Q4 as two borrowers complete KYC re-verification, assuming no further delays.'};
    if(/risk|expos/.test(s)) return {tag:'RISK', text:'Two borrowers represent 41% of critical-path spend \u2014 the leading source of concentration risk this quarter.'};
    return null;
  }
  submitAnalyzeRapidQuestion = () => {
    const q = this.state.analyzeRapidInput.trim(); if(!q) return;
    const match = this.rapidClassify(q);
    const card = match? {id:Date.now(), tag:match.tag, time:new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit'}), text:match.text} : {id:Date.now(), tag:null, time:new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit'}), text:"Grounded in what's qualified so far \u2014 nothing conclusive yet on that specific question."};
    this.setState(st=>({analyzeRapidCards:[...st.analyzeRapidCards, card], analyzeRapidInput:''}));
  };

    if(this.state.analyzeChatBusy) return;
    if(this.state.analyzeTab==='deepdive' && !this.state.deepDiveRun && !this.state.deepDiveLoading){
      this.setState(st=>({ analyzeChatInput:'', analyzeDeepDiveObjective:q,
        analyzeChatLog:[...(st.analyzeChatLog||[]), {q, a:'Running a deep dive against that objective. The synthesis is building on the left \u2014 it cites every file it reads.', cites:['Deep Dive \u00b7 ~420 credits'], effect:'\u2713 Deep dive started'}] }));
      this.runAnalyzeDeepDiveSynthesis();
      return;
    }
    const file = (this.state.analyzeFiles.find(f=>f.id===this.state.analyzeSelectedFileId)||{}).name || 'the selected file';
    this.setState({analyzeChatInput:'', analyzeChatBusy:true, analyzeChatPending:q, analyzeChatStep:0, analyzeChatFile:file});
    [600,1200,1800].forEach((t,i)=> setTimeout(()=>{ if(this.state.analyzeChatBusy) this.setState({analyzeChatStep:i+1}); }, t));
    setTimeout(()=>{
      const match = this.rapidClassify(q);
      const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit'});
      const entry = match
        ? {q, a:match.text, cites:[file, 'borrower_kyc_certifications.csv'], effect:'\u2713 Added to Rapid findings as '+match.tag}
        : {q, a:"Grounded in what's qualified so far \u2014 nothing conclusive yet on that specific question. Nothing was added to your findings.", cites:[file]};
      this.setState(st=>({
        analyzeChatBusy:false, analyzeChatPending:'', analyzeChatStep:0,
        analyzeChatLog:[...(st.analyzeChatLog||[]), entry],
        analyzeRapidCards: match? [...st.analyzeRapidCards, {id:Date.now(), tag:match.tag, time, text:match.text}] : st.analyzeRapidCards
      }));
    }, 2300);

    });

    const text = (this.state.tlInput||'').trim(); if(!text) return;
    this.setState(st=>{
      const flow = TL_FLOW[st.tlMode];
      const msgs = [...st.tlMessages, {from:'user', text}];
      const nextProbe = st.tlProbeIdx + 1;
      const probe = flow.probes[nextProbe];
      if(probe){ msgs.push({from:'akki', text:probe}); return {tlMessages:msgs, tlInput:'', tlProbeIdx:nextProbe}; }
      return {tlMessages:msgs, tlInput:'', tlProbeIdx:nextProbe, tlEngineShown:true};
    });
  };

  p360Answer(q){
    const t = q.toLowerCase();
    if(/goal|off track|off-track|worst/.test(t) && !/initiative|task|delivery|idea|owner|who /.test(t)) return {
      a:'Two goals are off track. Cost-to-serve is the deeper one — reassessed twice this quarter with no movement, and its two initiatives are both late. Margin recovery is off track on a single measure, not the whole goal.',
      cites:['Goals register','Q3 reassessment log'], effect:'✓ Goals filtered to Off Track', apply:{tab:'goals', status:'Off Track'} };
    if(/initiative|task|delivery|late|behind|milestone/.test(t)) return {
      a:'Of the tracked initiatives, three are behind their own milestone dates. Every one of them sits under a goal that is already at risk, so the goal status is not telling you anything new — the initiative dates are.',
      cites:['Initiative tracker'], effect:'✓ Switched to Initiative Status', apply:{tab:'initiatives'} };
    if(/signal|critical|early|warning/.test(t) && !/idea|recommend|suggest/.test(t)) return {
      a:'One critical signal is open: borrower concentration is rising while KYC re-verification slips. It carries three pieces of evidence and appears on two other boards, which is why it is ranked first.',
      cites:['Signals · critical','Cross-board context'], effect:'✓ Opened Signals, critical only', apply:{tab:'signals', severity:'Critical'} };
    if(/idea|recommend|suggest|akki think/.test(t)) return {
      a:'Akki is holding recommendations that each trace back to the signals above. They are labelled as generated, never as observed, so you can weigh them differently.',
      cites:['Ideas by Akki'], effect:'✓ Opened Ideas by Akki', apply:{tab:'ideas'} };
    if(/owner|who/.test(t)) return {
      a:'Goals are spread across four owners. The two off-track goals share one owner, which is the pattern worth raising before the next cycle.',
      cites:['Goals register · owners'] };
    return { a:'Nothing conclusive on that yet — what is measured here is goals, initiatives, open signals and the ideas drawn from them. Ask about any of those and the answer will cite its record.', cites:['Perform 360'] };
  }
  runP360Chat(q){
    if(this.state.p360ChatBusy) return;
    this.setState({p360ChatInput:'', p360ChatBusy:true, p360ChatPending:q, p360ChatStep:0});
    [600,1200,1800].forEach((t,i)=> setTimeout(()=>{ if(this.state.p360ChatBusy) this.setState({p360ChatStep:i+1}); }, t));
    setTimeout(()=>{
      const r = this.p360Answer(q);
      this.setState(st=>({ p360ChatBusy:false, p360ChatPending:'', p360ChatStep:0,
        p360ChatLog:[...(st.p360ChatLog||[]), {q, a:r.a, cites:r.cites, effect:r.effect}] }));
      const ap = r.apply;
      if(ap){
        if(ap.tab==='goals') this.setState({appOpen:'performance', navSub:'performance', perfTab:'objectives', perfStatusFilter: ap.status||'All'});
        if(ap.tab==='initiatives') this.setState({appOpen:'performance', navSub:'performance', perfTab:'tasks'});
        if(ap.tab==='signals') this.setState({appOpen:'signals', navSub:'signals', sigSeverity: ap.severity || 'all'});
        if(ap.tab==='ideas') this.setState({appOpen:'ideas', navSub:'ideas'});
      }
    }, 2300);
  }

  /* Shared opportunity-card view-model — used by the estate-wide Opportunities drawer AND the Source Profile drawer.
     Any design change to the card must be applied to both template blocks that consume this. */
  oppVM(o, s){
    const stageColor = o.stage==='Reviewed'? (o.outcome==='Declined'? 'var(--oxblood)' : 'var(--sage)') : o.stage==='In review'? 'var(--brass)' : 'var(--ink3)';
    const stageBg = o.stage==='Reviewed'? (o.outcome==='Declined'? 'rgba(184,57,91,.11)' : 'rgba(29,122,110,.12)') : o.stage==='In review'? 'rgba(176,141,46,.13)' : 'var(--surface2)';
    const stageLabel = o.stage==='Reviewed'? o.outcome : o.stage;
    const decisionLine = o.stage==='In review'? ('Pending with '+(o.pendingWith||'Approvals')+', sent '+(o.sinceDays===0?'today':(o.sinceDays+' day'+(o.sinceDays===1?'':'s')+' ago')))
      : o.stage==='Reviewed'? ('Decided by '+o.decidedBy+' on '+o.decidedOn+(o.outcome==='Declined'? (' \u2014 '+o.reason) : '')) : '';
    const isStale = o.stage==='In review' && o.quotedCensus < CURRENT_CENSUS;
    const roleDef = ROLES.find(r=>r.key===s.role);
    const isRequester = !!(roleDef && o.requestedBy && roleDef.person===o.requestedBy);
    return {key:'opp'+o.id, id:o.id, title:o.title, body:o.body, stageLabel, stageColor, stageBg, decisionLine, hasDecision: !!decisionLine,
      cost:o.cost||'\u2014', gpuHours:o.gpuHours||'\u2014', compute:o.compute||'\u2014',
      todo: o.todo||'',
      useLine: (o.gpuHours && o.gpuHours!=='\u2014')? ('About '+o.gpuHours.replace('~','')+' of training time on '+(o.compute||'shared compute').replace(' \u00d7 ',' \u00d7 ')+', reading '+o.source+'.') : ('Reads '+o.source+'. No training compute needed.'),
      costLine: (o.cost && o.cost!=='\u2014')? (o.cost.replace('~','About ')+(o.budget? (o.budget.fits!==false? ', which fits inside this month\u2019s remaining budget of '+o.budget.remaining+'.' : ', which is '+o.budget.over+' more than is left in this month\u2019s budget.') : '.')) : 'No cost estimated yet \u2014 nothing runs until one is.',
      costColor: (o.budget && o.budget.fits===false)? 'var(--brass)' : 'var(--ink2)',
      hasStart: !!o.consentRequired, startLine: o.consentRequired? 'Consent is needed from the owner of the '+o.source+' before anything can start.' : '',
      hasBudget: !!o.budget, budgetFits: !o.budget || o.budget.fits!==false,
      budgetLine: !o.budget? '' : (o.budget.fits!==false
        ? ((o.stage==='Reviewed'? 'Fit within ' : 'Fits within ')+o.budget.remaining+' remaining '+(o.stage==='Reviewed'? 'that' : 'this')+' month')
        : ('Exceeds remaining budget \u2014 '+o.budget.over+' over.')),
      basisOk: !o.consentRequired,
      basisLine: o.consentRequired
        ? 'Lawful basis: Regulatory Only material \u2014 consent required before this can proceed.'
        : ('Lawful basis: '+(o.basis||'legitimate interest')+' \u2014 sourced from '+(o.rightsClass||'Internal Only')+' material.'),
      hasWorkflow: o.stage==='Reviewed' && o.outcome==='Approved' && !!o.workflowId, workflowId:o.workflowId||'', onWorkflow: o.workflowId? this.oppToWorkflow(o) : null,
      isStale, staleBanner: isStale? ('Quoted before Census #'+CURRENT_CENSUS+' \u2014 may no longer reflect current state.') : '',
      showFresh: isStale && isRequester, onFresh: this.oppRefreshEstimate(o.id),
      showRequestReview: o.stage==='New' && o.cost && o.cost!=='\u2014' && o.gpuHours && o.gpuHours!=='\u2014',
      onRequestReview: this.oppRequestReview(o.id),
      statusIsDone: o.stage==='Reviewed',
      cardBorder: isStale? 'var(--brass)' : 'var(--line)',
      cardBorderWidth: isStale? '1.5px' : '1px',
      highlight: s.oppFocusId===o.id};
  }

  efBuildProfile(name, s){
    if(!name) return null;
    const row = ESTATE_FULL.find(r=>r.source===name);
    if(!row) return null;
    const det = PROFILE_DETAIL[name];
    const rs = rightsPillStyle(row.rights);
    const mixTabKey = s.efProfMixTab||'language';
    const mixSrc = det? (mixTabKey==='language'? det.mixLanguage : det.mixCondition) : [{label:'No detail on file yet', pct:100}];
    const measuredAmt = row.measured==='\u2014'? null : (row.tb*row.pct/100);
    const proof = measuredAmt!=null
      ? measuredAmt.toFixed(1)+' TB of '+row.tb.toFixed(1)+' TB measured ('+row.pct+'%) \u2014 counted directly from live rows, last measured '+row.measured+'.'
      : '0.0 TB of '+row.tb.toFixed(1)+' TB measured (0%) \u2014 not read in census #4.';
    const relationships = (det? det.relationships : []).map((r,i)=>{
      const dup = r.dupId? DUPLICATE_PAIRS.find(d=>d.id===r.dupId) : null;
      const dec = dup? s.dupDecision[dup.id] : null;
      const st = dec? dec.stage : null;
      const dupLabel = !dup? '' : !dec? 'Awaiting review'
        : st==='dismissed'? ('Dismissed by '+dec.by+' on '+dec.on+'.')
        : st==='pending'? 'Request for approval for reconciling duplicates sent'
        : st==='approved'? ('Confirmed by '+dec.by+' on '+dec.on+'. Reconciling approved by '+dec.approvedBy+' on '+dec.approvedOn+'.')
        : ('Confirmed by '+dec.by+' on '+dec.on+'. Reconciling approved by '+dec.approvedBy+' on '+dec.approvedOn+'. Reconciled on '+dec.reconciledOn+'.');
      return {key:'rel'+i, name:r.name, onOpen:this.efOpenRelated(r.name),
        typeLabel:r.type, isDup: !!dup,
        typeBg: dup? 'rgba(184,57,91,.12)' : 'var(--surface2)', typeColor: dup? 'var(--oxblood)' : 'var(--ink2)',
        hasConfidence: !dup, confidence:r.confidence||'', confColor:r.confColor||'var(--ink3)',
        evidence:r.evidence,
        dupUnresolved: !!dup && !dec, dupLabel, dupPairId: dup? dup.id : null,
        onConfirm: dup? this.confirmDup(dup.id) : null, onDismiss: dup? this.dismissDup(dup.id) : null};
    });
    const recommended = (s.opportunities||[]).filter(o=>o.source===row.source).map(o=>this.oppVM(o, s));
    const staleCount = recommended.filter(o=>o.isStale).length;
    const tblTotal = (det? det.tables : []).reduce((a,t)=>a+t.records,0)||1;
    const tablesBars = (det? det.tables : []).map((t,i)=>({key:'tb'+i, label:t.name, records:t.records.toLocaleString(), w:Math.round(t.records/tblTotal*100)+'%'}));
    const isPerception = !!(det && det.perception);
    return {
      open:true,
      header:{name:row.source, rightsLabel:row.rights, rightsBg:rs.bg, rightsColor:rs.color, rightsItalic: rs.italic?'italic':'normal', typeLabel:row.type, isDegraded: EF_COND_WORD[row.condCat]==='Degraded'},
      description: 'A '+row.type.toLowerCase()+' source, mapped by hand at connection'+(det? (' and confirmed by '+det.mappedBy+', '+det.mappedOn) : '')+(det? (' \u00b7 '+det.region) : '')+'.',
      metrics: [{key:'m_size', k:'Size', v:row.tb.toFixed(1)+' TB'}].concat(det? det.metrics.filter(m=>m.k!=='Quality').map((m,i)=>({key:'m'+i, k:m.k, v:m.v})) : [
        {key:'m0',k:'Records',v:'\u2014'},{key:'m1',k:'Fields mapped',v:'\u2014'},{key:'m2',k:'PII flagged',v:'\u2014'},
        {key:'m4',k:'Rights',v:row.rights},{key:'m5',k:'Extracted',v:row.pct+'%'},{key:'m6',k:'Data type',v:row.type},{key:'m7',k:'Languages observed',v:row.langs}
      ]),
      qualityState: row.quality,
      qualityReason: QUALITY_REASONS[row.source] || 'Not yet cross-checked against another source.',
      proof,
      hasPerception: isPerception,
      perception: isPerception? (det.perception.count+' processed at an average '+det.perception.confidence+' confidence, in '+det.perception.mode+' mode, using the '+det.perception.model+'. Full per-group detail is in Contents below.') : '',
      mixTabs:[['language','By language'],['condition','By condition']].map(t=>({key:t[0], label:t[1], onClick:this.efMixTab(t[0]),
        color: mixTabKey===t[0]?'var(--ink)':'var(--ink3)', border: mixTabKey===t[0]?'var(--ink)':'transparent'})),
      mixRows: mixSrc.map((r,i)=>({key:'mx'+i, label:r.label, pct:r.pct+'%', w:r.pct+'%'})),
      hasRelationships: relationships.length>0, relationships,
      hasRecommended: recommended.length>0, recommended,
      hasStale: staleCount>0, staleText: staleCount+' need'+(staleCount===1?'s':'')+' a fresh estimate',
      hasTables: tablesBars.length>0, tablesBars,
      isPerceptionContents: isPerception,
      contentsStructured: (det && det.contentsStructured)? det.contentsStructured.map((c,i)=>({key:'cs'+i, ...c})) : [],
      contentsPerception: (det && det.contentsPerception)? det.contentsPerception.map((c,i)=>({key:'cp'+i, ...c})) : []
    };
  }
  efFiltered(s){
    const q = (s.efSearch||'').trim().toLowerCase();
    const rights = s.efRights||[], types = s.efTypes||[], notMeasured = !!s.efNotMeasured;
    return ESTATE_FULL.filter(r=>{
      if(q && !(r.source.toLowerCase().includes(q) || r.type.toLowerCase().includes(q))) return false;
      if(rights.length && !rights.includes(r.rights)) return false;
      if(types.length && !types.includes(r.type)) return false;
      if(notMeasured && r.rights!=='Not measured') return false;
      return true;
    });
  }
  efBreakdown(rows, key){
    const total = rows.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.tb, 0) || 1;
    const map = new Map();
    rows.forEach(r=>{ const k=r[key]; map.set(k, (map.get(k)||0)+r.tb); });
    return [...map.entries()].sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).map(([k,v],i)=>{
      const un = /not measured|not yet measured|never read/i.test(k);
      return {key:'b'+i, label:k, w:Math.round(v/total*100)+'%', size:v.toFixed(1)+' TB \u00b7 '+Math.round(v/total*100)+'%',
        bar: un? this.MIX_HATCH : 'rgba(15,27,51,.07)',
        labelColor: un? 'var(--ink3)' : 'var(--ink2)', valueColor: un? 'var(--ink3)' : 'var(--ink)'};
    });
  }

  censusScrollRefCallback = (node) => {
    if(this._censusScrollNode === node) return;
    if(this._censusScrollNode) this._censusScrollNode.removeEventListener('scroll', this._onCensusScroll);

  _onCensusScroll = () => {
    const node = this._censusScrollNode; if(!node) return;

  };
  _censusTick = () => {
    const st = this.state, now = Date.now();
    if(st.censusRunning){
      if(now - st.censusStartedAt < CENSUS_RUN_MS){ this.forceUpdate(); return; }
      const prev = st.censusHistory[0];
      const prevData = parseFloat(prev.dataLabel), prevMeasured = parseInt(prev.measuredLabel,10), prevVerified = parseInt(prev.verifiedLabel,10), prevPii = parseInt(prev.piiLabel,10);
      const deltaTb = Math.round((1 + Math.random()*1.5)*10)/10;
      const measuredDelta = 2 + Math.round(Math.random()*2);
      const verifiedDelta = 1 + Math.round(Math.random()*2);
      const piiDelta = Math.random() > 0.6 ? 1 : 0;
      const entry = { num: prev.num+1, runBy:'You', at: st.censusStartedAt, durationMs: now - st.censusStartedAt,
        checkedLabel:'Sources checked: 12 of 12.', excludedNote:'',
        dataLabel: (Math.round((prevData+deltaTb)*10)/10)+' TB', deltaLabel:'+'+deltaTb+' TB vs previous run',
        measuredLabel: Math.min(97, prevMeasured+measuredDelta)+'%', measuredDelta:'+'+measuredDelta+' pts',
        verifiedLabel: Math.min(92, prevVerified+verifiedDelta)+'%', verifiedDelta:'+'+verifiedDelta+' pts',
        piiLabel: (prevPii+piiDelta)+'%', piiDelta: piiDelta ? '+1 pt' : '+0 pts' };
      this.setState(s => ({censusRunning:false, censusStartedAt:null, censusHistory:[entry, ...s.censusHistory], censusLastRunAt: entry.at + entry.durationMs}));
    } else if(now >= st.censusLastRunAt + CENSUS_INTERVAL_MS){
      this.setState({censusRunning:true, censusStartedAt: now});
    }
  };

  docAnswer(q){
    const x = q.toLowerCase();
    if(/create|start a|new doc|new report|new deck|write me|draft a/.test(x)) return {
      a:'Started it in the middle. I will ask what it is for, who reads it and what it must land — then compose only from sources that qualify.',
      cites:['Create a Document'], effect:'✓ Opened Create a Document', apply:{wiz:'create'} };
    if(/enhance|improve|tighten|sharpen|rewrite|strengthen/.test(x)) return {
      a:'Enhance is open. Point me at a document and tell me what to improve; the original stays intact and the change is recorded against it.',
      cites:['Enhance a Document'], effect:'✓ Opened Enhance a Document', apply:{wiz:'enhance'} };
    if(/compile|assemble|pull together|combine|pack from/.test(x)) return {
      a:'Compile is open. Pick the sources and I will build one document from them, carrying each claim with the evidence class it arrived with.',

  wizSubmitText = () => {
    const w = this.state.docWiz; const text = (w.input||'').trim();
    if(!text) return;
    if(!w.path){
      const t = text.toLowerCase();
      const path = t.includes('enhance')? 'enhance' : t.includes('compile')? 'compile' : 'create';
      this.setState(st=>({docWiz:{...st.docWiz, path, stageIdx:0, input:'', messages:[...st.docWiz.messages, {from:'user', text}, {from:'akki', text:WIZ_PATHS[path].stages[0].ask}]}}));
      return;
    }
    this.wizAnswer(text);
  };
  wizAnswer(value){
    this.setState(st=>{
      const w = st.docWiz; const def = WIZ_PATHS[w.path]; const stage = def.stages[w.stageIdx];
      const answers = {...w.answers, [stage.key]: value};
      const messages = [...w.messages, {from:'user', text: String(value)}];
      const nextIdx = w.stageIdx + 1;
      if(nextIdx < def.stages.length){
        const next = def.stages[nextIdx];
        if(next.ask) messages.push({from:'akki', text: next.ask});
        else messages.push({from:'akki', text:'Here\u2019s everything you\u2019ve set. Change anything before I generate.'});
        return { docWiz:{...w, stageIdx:nextIdx, answers, messages, input:''} };
      }
      return { docWiz:{...w, answers, messages, input:''} };
    });
  }

  trafficLine(series, fmt, lo, hi){
    const min = lo!=null? lo : Math.min.apply(null, series);
    const max = hi!=null? hi : Math.max.apply(null, series);
    const flat = max===min;
    const x = i => 6 + i*(468/11);
    const y = v => flat? 52 : 96 - ((v-min)/(max-min))*88;
    return {
      points: series.map((v,i)=> x(i).toFixed(1)+','+y(v).toFixed(1)).join(' '),
      dots: series.map((v,i)=>{
        const last = i===series.length-1;
        return {key:'d'+i, cx:x(i).toFixed(1), cy:y(v).toFixed(1), r: last? 3.4 : 2.6,
          fill: last? '#fff' : 'currentColor', sw: last? 1.7 : 0, label: TRAFFIC_MONTHS[i]+': '+fmt(v)};
      }),
      labels: TRAFFIC_MONTHS.map((m,i)=>({key:'l'+i, left:(x(i)/480*100).toFixed(2)+'%', t:m,
        fill: i===series.length-1? 'var(--ink)' : 'var(--ink3)'})),
      range: 'High '+fmt(Math.max.apply(null, series))+' \u00b7 low '+fmt(Math.min.apply(null, series))
    };
  }

  tmStamp(mins){
    const d = new Date(Date.now() - mins*60000), now = new Date();
    if(mins < 1) return 'Just now';
    if(mins < 60) return Math.round(mins)+'m ago';
    if(mins < 1440) return Math.floor(mins/60)+'h ago';
    const hm = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');
    if(mins < 10080) return ['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat'][d.getDay()]+' '+hm;
    const MON=['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
    return d.getDate()+' '+MON[d.getMonth()]+(d.getFullYear()!==now.getFullYear()? ' '+d.getFullYear() : '');
  }
  tmDayLabel(mins){
    const d = new Date(Date.now() - mins*60000), n = new Date();
    const dd = Math.round((new Date(n.getFullYear(),n.getMonth(),n.getDate()) - new Date(d.getFullYear(),d.getMonth(),d.getDate()))/86400000);
    if(dd===0) return 'Today';
    if(dd===1) return 'Yesterday';
    if(dd<7) return ['Sunday','Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday'][d.getDay()];
    const MON=['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
    return d.getDate()+' '+MON[d.getMonth()]+(d.getFullYear()!==n.getFullYear()? ' '+d.getFullYear() : '');
  }
  tmThreadItems(msgs, objective, run){
    const out=[]; let prev=null;
    const ORD=['shaping','approval','training','testing','service']; let stg='shaping';
    const bump=s=>{ if(ORD.indexOf(s)>ORD.indexOf(stg)) stg=s; };
    run = run || {};
    const ageM = run.submittedMins==null? null : run.submittedMins, rem = run.reminderMins;
    const ago = m => m<60? 'just now' : (m<1440? Math.floor(m/60)+'h ago' : Math.round(m/1440)+'d ago');
    const canRemind = ageM!=null && ageM>=2880 && (rem==null || rem>=1440);
    const remindLabel = (rem!=null && rem<1440)? 'Reminder sent '+ago(rem) : (ageM!=null && ageM<2880? 'Available after 48 hours' : 'Send reminder');

    const qLine = run.qPos? (ordq(run.qPos)+' in line \u00b7 ~'+run.qMins+' min until start') : 'Slot open \u2014 starting now';
    (msgs||[]).forEach((m,i)=>{
      if(m.divider) out.push({key:'dv'+i, isDivider:true, isMsg:false, label:m.divider});
      else if(prev===null || (prev - m.mins) > 360) out.push({key:'d'+i, isDivider:true, isMsg:false, label:this.tmDayLabel(m.mins)});
      const chk = ((run.status==='Testing' && run.chk)? run.chk : (m.checks||[])).map((c,j)=>({key:'c'+j, n:c.n, v:c.v||'', label: c.s==='settled'?'Settled':(c.s==='measuring'?'Measuring\u2026':'Pending'),

        nameColor: c.s==='pending'? 'var(--ink3)' : 'var(--ink2)'}));
      const tx=(m.text||'').toLowerCase();
      if(m.widget==='approval'||m.widget==='queue'||/spend request|auto-approve|over the limit|approved by|declined by/.test(tx)) bump('approval');
      if(m.widget==='status'||/training has started|training is running|slot opened/.test(tx)) bump('training');
      if(m.widget==='checks'||m.widget==='record'||m.widget==='suggest'||m.widget==='refused'||m.widget==='doc'||/acceptance checks|refused at acceptance/.test(tx)) bump('testing');
      if(/approval queue|approved by|in service|weekly recheck/.test(tx)) bump('service');
      const isUser = m.role==='user';
      out.push({stage:stg, key:'m'+i, isDivider:false, isMsg:true, isUser, isAkki:!isUser,
        text:m.text, ts:this.tmStamp(m.mins), who:isUser?'You':'Akki',
        align: isUser? 'flex-end' : 'flex-start', tsAlign: isUser? 'right' : 'left',
        bubbleBg: isUser? 'rgba(76,95,213,.07)' : 'var(--surface)',
        bubbleBorder: isUser? 'rgba(76,95,213,.20)' : 'var(--line)',
        hasStatus:m.widget==='status', statusLabel: run.kind==='extract'? 'Extracting' : (run.kind==='skill'? 'Building' : 'Training'), statusLine: (m.widget==='status' && run.tElapsed!=null && run.status==='In training')?
          ('Started '+this.tmDur(run.tElapsed)+' ago \u00b7 adapting from '+(run.baseline||'the chosen baseline')+' \u00b7 ~'+this.tmDur(run.tLeft)+' left') : (m.statusLine||''),
        hasChecks:m.widget==='checks', checks:chk,
        hasRefused:m.widget==='refused', reason:m.reason||'',
        hasObjective:m.widget==='objective', objFields, objStatement: objective? objective.statement : '',
        hasApproval:m.widget==='approval', apprLine, canRemind, remindDisabled:!canRemind, remindLabel,
        hasRecord:m.widget==='record', recRows:(m.record? m.record.rows.map((rw,j)=>({key:'rr'+j, k:rw[0], v:rw[1]})) : []), recLearnings:(m.record? m.record.learnings : ''),
        hasSuggest:m.widget==='suggest', hasDoc:m.widget==='doc', hasBegin:m.widget==='begin',
        hasBubble: !!m.text,
        hasBaseline:m.widget==='baseline', blName:sug?sug.name:'', blBecause:sug?sug.because:'', blEvidence:sug?sug.evidence:'',
        blShowToggle: !run.altsShown, onUseSug: blSel? this.tmUseBaseline(blSel.sug) : null,
        hasBaselineAlts:m.widget==='baselineAlts', altCards,
        hasSources:m.widget==='sources', srcRows:(this.tmC(run,'SOURCES')||this.TM_SOURCES).map((sr,j)=>({key:'s'+j, n:sr.n, v:sr.v, cls:sr.cls,
          clsColor: sr.cls==='Regulatory'? 'var(--oxblood)' : (sr.cls==='Internal'? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--brass)'),
          clsBg: sr.cls==='Regulatory'? 'rgba(184,57,91,.12)' : (sr.cls==='Internal'? 'rgba(76,95,213,.10)' : 'rgba(176,141,46,.16)')})),
        hasRights:m.widget==='rights', rightsRows:this.TM_RIGHTS.map((rr,j)=>({key:'g'+j, k:rr.k, v:rr.v})),
        hasThink: !!(m.think && m.think.length),
        thinkLabel: (m.think? ('How I got here \u00b7 '+m.think.length+' step'+(m.think.length>1?'s':'')) : ''),
        thinkOpen: !!((this.state.tmThink||{})[(run.id||'')+':'+i]),
        thinkClosed: !((this.state.tmThink||{})[(run.id||'')+':'+i]),
        thinkSteps: (m.think||[]).map((tx,j)=>({key:'k'+j, t:tx, line: j===(m.think.length-1)? 'transparent' : 'var(--line)', pad: j===(m.think.length-1)? '0' : '14px'})),
        onThink: this.tmToggleThink((run.id||'')+':'+i),
        hasRemodel:m.widget==='remodel', remodelName:this.tmLineageNext(run.name),
        hasReflect:m.widget==='reflect', reflRows, reflHead,
        hasQueue:m.widget==='queue', qName:run.name||'', qLine,
        hasContinue:m.widget==='continue', contRows});
      prev = m.mins;
    });
    return out;
  }
  tmShapeObjective(t){
    const low=t.toLowerCase();
    const METRIC=[['recall','Recall'],['precision','Precision'],['accuracy','Accuracy'],['f1','F1'],['agreement','Agreement with the manual sample']];
    const hit=METRIC.find(m=>low.indexOf(m[0])>=0);
    const num=t.match(/(\d{1,3})\s*%|0?\.\d{2,3}/);
    const par = num? (num[0].indexOf('%')>=0? (parseInt(num[0],10)/100).toFixed(2) : String(parseFloat(num[0]).toFixed(2))) : '0.80';
    return {statement:t, fields:[
      {n:'Quality bar', v:(hit? hit[1] : 'Recall')+' on held-out material', state: hit? 'Confirmed':'Assumed',
       why:'Quality bar assumed: you did not name a measure, so I took recall on held-out material \u2014 the measure Model Approval applies when none is given.'},
      {n:'Success parameter', v:'at or above '+par, state: num? 'Confirmed':'Assumed',
       why:'Success parameter assumed: you did not give a number, so I took 0.80, the standing minimum for this class of model.'}
    ]};
  }
  tmReshape(obj, t){
    const n=this.tmShapeObjective(t);
    return {...obj, fields: obj.fields.map((f,i)=> n.fields[i].state==='Confirmed'? {...f, v:n.fields[i].v, state:'Confirmed'} : f)};
  }
  tmObjectiveAnswer(obj){
    const conf = obj.fields.filter(f=>f.state==='Confirmed').map(f=>f.n.toLowerCase()+' at '+f.v);
    const asm = obj.fields.filter(f=>f.state==='Assumed');
    if(!asm.length) return 'Nothing is assumed in this thread. Confirmed by you: '+conf.join(', and ')+'.';
    return 'Still assumed in this thread: '+asm.map(f=>f.n.toLowerCase()+', '+f.v).join('; and ')+'.'+(conf.length? ' Confirmed by you: '+conf.join(', and ')+'.' : ' Nothing is confirmed yet.');
  }

  TM_STAGE1_OPEN = 'What do you want this model to do?';
  tmParseTask(t){
    const V=['classify','flag','score','rank','extract','detect','tag','predict','match','summarise','summarize','sort','spot','identify','group','pull'];
    const low=t.toLowerCase();
    const idx=V.map(v=>low.indexOf(v)).filter(i=>i>=0);
    if(!idx.length) return null;
    let clause=t.slice(Math.min.apply(null, idx)).split(/[.;\n]|\bwith recall\b|\band it works\b|\bit works\b|\bsuccess is\b/)[0].trim().replace(/[,\s]+$/,'');
    if(clause.length<7) return null;
    return clause.charAt(0).toLowerCase()+clause.slice(1);
  }
  tmParseMetric(t){
    const num=t.match(/(\d{1,3})\s*%|0?\.\d{2,3}/); if(!num) return null;
    const low=t.toLowerCase();
    const M=[['recall','recall'],['precision','precision'],['accuracy','accuracy'],['agreement','agreement with the manual sample'],['f1','F1']];
    const hit=M.find(m=>low.indexOf(m[0])>=0);
    const val=num[0].indexOf('%')>=0? (parseInt(num[0],10)/100).toFixed(2) : parseFloat(num[0]).toFixed(2);
    return {metric: hit? hit[1] : null, val};
  }
  tmProposeParam(qual){
    const q=(qual||'').toLowerCase();
    if(/flag|detect|spot|risk|anomal|breach|drift|miss/.test(q)) return {metric:'recall', val:'0.85', why:'Missing a real case is costlier than a false alarm here, so I\u2019d lean on a recall minimum'};
    if(/extract|pull|tag|term|clause/.test(q)) return {metric:'precision', val:'0.90', why:'A wrong extracted term travels further than a missed one, so precision is the tighter constraint'};
    return {metric:'agreement with the manual sample', val:'0.82', why:'You already have a manual sample to compare against, so agreement is the honest measure'};
  }
  tmStageAnswer(s1){
    if(s1.qual && s1.succ) return 'Nothing is assumed. You gave the output \u2014 '+s1.qual+' \u2014 and the number, '+s1.succ.metric+' at '+s1.succ.val+'.';
    if(s1.proposed) return 'One thing here is mine, not yours: I proposed '+s1.proposed.metric+' at '+s1.proposed.val+', and you have not agreed to it yet.'+(s1.qual? ' The output is yours: '+s1.qual+'.' : ' The output is still missing.');
    if(s1.qual) return 'So far, only what you told me: '+s1.qual+'. No measure yet, and I have not put one in for you.';
    return 'Nothing recorded yet \u2014 you have not told me what the model produces.';
  }
  tmSetAbove = () => this.setState({tmAbove:true});
  tmSetBelow = () => this.setState({tmAbove:false});
  tmBeginNow = () => {
    const k = this.tmKey(this.state), id = this.state.tmSel, above = !!this.state.tmAbove;
    this.setState(s=>({[k]: s[k].map(r=> r.id!==id? r : (above?
      {...r, began:true, status:'In Approval', approver:'D. Okafor', submittedMins:0, reminderMins:null,
       msgs:r.msgs.concat([{role:'akki', mins:0, text:'That\u2019s over the limit for auto-approve, so a Spend Request has gone to D. Okafor. Nothing runs until it is signed.'},
                           {role:'akki', mins:0, text:'', widget:'approval'}])} :
      {...r, began:true, status:'Queued', qPos:4, qMins:35,
       msgs:r.msgs.concat([{role:'akki', mins:0, text:'That\u2019s within auto-approve range, so no signature is needed \u2014 queuing it now.'},
                           {role:'akki', mins:0, text:'', widget:'queue'}])}))}));
    if(above) this._tmDT = setTimeout(()=>this.tmDecision(id, k), 6000); else this.tmQueueTimers(id, k);
  };
  tmDecision(id, k){
    this.setState(s=>({[k]: s[k].map(r=> r.id!==id? r : {...r, status:'Queued', qPos:4, qMins:35,

                          {role:'akki', mins:0, text:'', widget:'queue'}])})}));
    this.tmQueueTimers(id, k);
  }
  tmQueueTimers(id, k){

    this._tmQ3 = setTimeout(()=>this.setState(s=>({[k]: s[k].map(r=> r.id!==id? r : {...r, status:'In training', qPos:null, qMins:null, tElapsed:0, tLeft:480,
      msgs:r.msgs.concat([{role:'akki', mins:0, divider:'14 min later', text:'A slot opened, so training has started. Real cost starts accruing from here.', think:['A card freed on the internal cluster, so the run moved out of the queue.','Called the start out explicitly because this is the moment real cost begins.','Set the estimate from the recipe and the material volume, not from the queue wait.']},
                          {role:'akki', mins:0, text:'', widget:'status'}])})})), 34000);
    this._tmQ4 = setTimeout(()=>this.tmTrainTimers(id, k), 34200);
  }
  TM_CHECKS = [

    {n:'Calibration check', v:'Brier 0.08 \u00b7 limit 0.12'},

  ];
  tmChkState(states, fail){ return this.TM_CHECKS.map((c,i)=>({n:c.n, s:states[i],
    v: states[i]==='settled'? ((fail && i===0)? '0.71 \u00b7 minimum 0.85' : c.v) : ''})); }
  tmTestTimers(id, k){
    const P='pending', M='measuring', S='settled', fail = !!this.state.tmFail;
    const seq = [
      [5000,  [S,M,P,P,P,P]],
      [10000, [S,M,P,M,P,P]],
      [15000, [S,S,M,M,P,P]],
      [20000, [S,S,M,S,P,P]],
      [25000, [S,S,S,S,M,M]],
      [31000, [S,S,S,S,S,S]]
    ];
    seq.forEach(([d, states])=>setTimeout(()=>this.setState(s=>({[k]: s[k].map(r=> r.id!==id? r : {...r, chk:this.tmChkState(states, fail)})})), d));
    this._tmS3 = setTimeout(()=>this.setState(s=>({[k]: s[k].map(r=> r.id!==id? r : (fail?
      {...r, status:'Refused', unread:1, msgs:r.msgs.concat([

      {...r, status:'Approval queue', detail:'Passed technically \u00b7 awaiting business approval', msgs:r.msgs.concat([
        {role:'akki', mins:0, text:'6 of 6 \u2014 '+r.name+' passed. Here\u2019s the full record.'},
        {role:'akki', mins:0, text:'', widget:'record', record:{rows:[

          ['Cost & time', '\u00a3392 against \u00a3420 estimated \u00b7 7h 40m against 8h']],
          learnings:'Most of the lift looks like it came from the certification register rather than the contract text \u2014 the Swahili slice only improved once the register was joined. That reads as the register carrying the signal, but it is inference from one run, not a measured finding.'}},
        {role:'akki', mins:0, widget:'suggest', text:'It cleared its recall minimum by a wider margin than 90% of comparable runs in this version history \u2014 0.89 against a minimum of 0.85. Two ways to write that up, and they carry different weight: a white paper stays inside the estate and needs no licence review, while an open-source release leaves it and cannot be withdrawn. I\u2019d suggest the white paper now, and only look at release if the margin holds through a second run.'}])}))})), 32500);
  }
  TM_GROUPS = [['Running',['In training','Testing','Queued']],['Shaping',['Shaping']],['In approval',['In Approval']],['In service',['In service']],['Refused',['Refused']],['Retired',['Retired']]];
  TM_LIFECYCLE = [['shaping','Shape'],['approval','Approve'],['training','Train'],['testing','Test'],['service','Accept']];
