  tmPct(r){
    const S=r.status;
    if(r.kind==='skill'){
      if(S==='Published'||S==='Retired') return 100;
      if(S==='Refused') return 88;
      if(S==='Trialling') return 90;
      if(S==='Building'){ if(r.tElapsed==null) return 70; const tot=r.tElapsed+(r.tLeft||0);
        return 60+Math.round(25*(tot? r.tElapsed/tot : 0)); }
      if(S==='Queued') return 52;
      if(S==='In Approval') return 44;
      if(r.ready) return 38;
      if(r.step5!=null) return 34;
      if(r.step4!=null) return 30;
      if(r.baseline) return 26;
      return 6+Math.min(6,(r.step||0))*3;
    }
    if(r.kind==='extract'){
      if(S==='Delivered') return 100;
      if(S==='Retired') return 100;
      if(S==='Refused') return 88;
      if(S==='Verifying') return 90;
      if(S==='Extracting'){ if(r.tElapsed==null) return 70; const tot=r.tElapsed+(r.tLeft||0);
        return 60+Math.round(25*(tot? r.tElapsed/tot : 0)); }
      if(S==='Queued') return 52;
      if(S==='In Approval') return 44;
      if(r.ready) return 38;
      if(r.step5!=null) return 34;
      if(r.step4!=null) return 30;
      if(r.baseline) return 26;
      return 6+Math.min(6,(r.step||0))*3;
    }
    if(S==='In service'||S==='Retired') return 100;
    if(S==='Refused') return 92;
    if(S==='Testing'){ const ck=(r.msgs||[]).filter(m=>m.widget==='checks').pop();
      const set=ck? ck.checks.filter(c=>c.s==='settled').length : 0; return 85+Math.round(set/6*14); }
    if(S==='In training'){ if(r.tElapsed==null) return 60; const tot=r.tElapsed+(r.tLeft||0);
      return 55+Math.round(29*(tot? r.tElapsed/tot : 0)); }
    if(S==='Queued') return 50;
    if(S==='In Approval') return 40;
    if(r.ready) return 34;
    if(r.step5!=null) return 32;
    if(r.step4!=null) return 30;
    if(r.baseline) return 26;
    return 8+Math.min(3,(r.step||0))*6;
  }
  tmJournalRows(r){
    const rec=(r.msgs||[]).find(m=>m.widget==='record');
    if(rec) return rec.record.rows.map((rw,j)=>({key:'j'+j, k:rw[0], v:rw[1]}));
    const out=[{key:'j0', k:'Objective', v:r.obj||'\u2014'}];
    if(r.baseline) out.push({key:'j1', k:'Baseline', v:r.baseline});
    const ref=(r.msgs||[]).find(m=>m.widget==='refused');
    if(ref) out.push({key:'j2', k:'Outcome', v:'Refused at acceptance'}, {key:'j3', k:'Reason', v:ref.reason});
    else if(r.status==='Retired'){ const last=(r.msgs||[])[r.msgs.length-1];
      out.push({key:'j4', k:'Outcome', v:'Retired'}, {key:'j5', k:'Recorded', v:last? last.text : '\u2014'}); }
    else if(r.status==='In service') out.push({key:'j6', k:'Outcome', v:'In service'});
    return out;
  }
  tmJToggle(id){ return () => this.setState(st=>{ const k=this.tmKey(st);
    return {tmSel:id, tmComposer:'', tmTopOpen:false, tmTab:'overview',
      [k]: st[k].map(r=> r.id===id? {...r, unread:0, hideBefore: r.hideBefore==null? r.msgs.length : r.hideBefore} : r)}; }); }
  tmGoStage(key){ return () => { const log=this._tmLog.current; if(!log) return;

  tmDur(m){ if(m==null) return '\u2014'; if(m<60) return m+'m';
    if(m>=1440){ const d=Math.floor(m/1440), hh=Math.round((m%1440)/60); return hh? d+'d '+hh+'h' : d+'d'; }
    const h=Math.floor(m/60), r=m%60; return r? h+'h '+r+'m' : h+'h'; }
  tmEta(r){
    const S=r.status;
    if(S==='In training') return r.tLeft!=null? '~'+this.tmDur(r.tLeft)+' to completion' : 'training';
    if(S==='Testing') return '~'+this.tmDur(r.etaMins||25)+' to completion';
    if(S==='Queued') return r.qMins!=null? '~'+this.tmDur(r.qMins)+' to start' : 'waiting for a slot';
    if(S==='In Approval') return r.submittedMins!=null? 'waiting on approval \u00b7 '+this.tmDur(r.submittedMins)+' so far' : 'waiting on approval';
    if(r.kind==='skill'){
      if(S==='Published') return 'in service';
      if(S==='Building') return r.tLeft!=null? '~'+this.tmDur(r.tLeft)+' to completion' : 'building';
      if(S==='Trialling') return '~'+this.tmDur(r.etaMins||12)+' to completion';
      if(S==='Refused') return 'stopped at trial';
      if(S==='Retired') return 'retired';
    }
    if(S==='Extracting') return r.tLeft!=null? '~'+this.tmDur(r.tLeft)+' to completion' : 'reading';
    if(S==='Verifying') return '~'+this.tmDur(r.etaMins||6)+' to completion';
    if(S==='Delivered') return 'delivered';
    if(S==='Shaping') return 'not started \u2014 no compute spent';
    if(S==='Refused') return 'stopped at acceptance';
    if(S==='In service') return 'complete';
    if(S==='Retired') return 'retired';
    return '';
  }
  tmTrainTimers(id, k){
    const push = (delay, patch, msg) => setTimeout(()=>this.setState(s=>({[k]: s[k].map(r=> r.id!==id? r : {...r, ...patch, msgs:r.msgs.concat([msg])})})), delay);

    this._tmR3 = setTimeout(()=>{ this.setState(s=>({[k]: s[k].map(r=> r.id!==id? r : {...r, status:'Testing', tElapsed:460, tLeft:0, chk:this.tmChkState(['measuring','pending','pending','pending','pending','pending'], !!this.state.tmFail),
      msgs:r.msgs.concat([{role:'akki', mins:0, divider:'2 hours later', text:'Training compute finished \u2014 7h 40m against an 8h estimate. The six acceptance checks are now running against held-out data. No one can override the result, including me.'},
        {role:'akki', mins:0, text:'', widget:'checks'}])})}));

  }

  TM_FINISHED = ['In service','Refused','Retired','Delivered'];
  tmLineageNext(name){
    const base = String(name||'model').replace(/-v\d+$/,'');
    let max=0;
    this.state.tmRuns.forEach(r=>{ const m=String(r.name).match(/-v(\d+)$/);
      if(m && String(r.name).replace(/-v\d+$/,'')===base) max=Math.max(max, parseInt(m[1],10)); });
    return base+'-v'+(max+1);
  }
  tmRemodel = () => this.setState(st=>{
    const parent = st.tmRuns.find(r=>r.id===st.tmSel); if(!parent) return {};
    const name = this.tmLineageNext(parent.name);
    const id = 'TRN-'+String(30 + st.tmRuns.length);
    const run = {id, name, obj:parent.obj, status:'Shaping', unread:0, step:0, lineage:parent.id,
      msgs:[{role:'akki', mins:0, text:'New run opened as '+name+'. '+parent.name+' is untouched \u2014 it keeps its record, its status and its calls.'},
            {role:'akki', mins:0, text:'What\u2019s the objective for this version?'}]};
    return {tmRuns:[run, ...st.tmRuns], tmSel:id, tmComposer:'', tmJOpen:null};
  });
  tmSetTab(k){ return () => this.setState({tmTab:k}); }
  tmReportView(r){
    const rec=(r.msgs||[]).find(m=>m.widget==='record');
    const ref=(r.msgs||[]).find(m=>m.widget==='refused');
    const rows=rec? rec.record.rows : [];
    const get=k=>{ const f=rows.find(x=>x[0]===k); return f? f[1] : null; };
    const secs=[];
    if(rec){
      secs.push({key:'s1', k:'Performance against minimums', v:get('Six checks')||'\u2014'});
      secs.push({key:'s2', k:'Training recipe', v:get('Recipe')||'\u2014'});
      secs.push({key:'s3', k:'Material it read', v:[get('Data classes'), get('Volumes')].filter(Boolean).join(' \u00b7 ')||'\u2014'});
      secs.push({key:'s4', k:'Cost and time against estimate', v:[get('Cost'), get('Time')].filter(Boolean).join(' \u00b7 ')||'\u2014'});
    } else if(ref){
      secs.push({key:'s1', k:'Where it fell short', v:ref.reason});
      secs.push({key:'s2', k:'Acceptance record', v:'None written \u2014 the run stopped at acceptance, so no Tier 1 record exists.'});
    } else {
      secs.push({key:'s1', k:'Acceptance record', v:'None written for this run.'});
      if(r.baseline) secs.push({key:'s2', k:'Baseline', v:r.baseline});
    }
    return secs;
  }
  tmReportLead(r){
    if(r.status==='In service') return 'Cleared all six acceptance checks and has stayed above its minimum on every recheck since.';
    if(r.status==='Refused') return 'Stopped at acceptance. Nothing about the run is hidden, and the reason travels with it.';
    return 'Retired with its reason recorded. Weights kept, calls disabled.';
  }
  tmReportObs(r){

    return 'Nothing further was observed after retirement.';
  }

  tmDashCards(r){
    const tiles=this.tmDashTiles(r).map(t=>({key:t.key, l:t.l, v:t.v, big:true, vSize:'19px', vFam:'var(--head)', span:'auto'}));
    const rows=this.tmJournalRows(r).filter(x=>['Six checks','Cost','Time','Objective'].indexOf(x.k)<0)
      .map(x=>({key:'c'+x.key, l:x.k, v:x.v, big:false, vSize:'12px', vFam:'inherit',

  tmDashTiles(r){
    const rec=(r.msgs||[]).find(m=>m.widget==='record');
    const rows=rec? rec.record.rows : [];
    const get=k=>{ const f=rows.find(x=>x[0]===k); return f? f[1] : null; };
    const out=[];
    const six=get('Six checks');
    if(six){
      const c=six.match(/(\d+)\s*of\s*(\d+)/); if(c) out.push({key:'t1', l:'Checks cleared', v:c[1]+'/'+c[2]});
      const m=six.match(/([a-z]+)\s+(0?\.\d{2})/i); if(m) out.push({key:'t2', l:m[1].charAt(0).toUpperCase()+m[1].slice(1), v:m[2]});
    }
    const cost=get('Cost'); if(cost){ const m=cost.match(/[\u00a3$\u20ac]?[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?/); if(m) out.push({key:'t3', l:'Cost', v:m[0]}); }
    const time=get('Time'); if(time){ const m=time.match(/^[\dhm\s]+/); if(m) out.push({key:'t4', l:'Time', v:m[0].trim()}); }
    const ref=(r.msgs||[]).find(m=>m.widget==='refused');
    if(!rec && ref){
      const nums=(ref.reason.match(/0?\.\d{2}/g)||[]);
      if(nums[0]) out.push({key:'t1', l:'Measured', v:nums[0]});
      if(nums[1]) out.push({key:'t2', l:'Minimum', v:nums[1]});
    }
    return out;
  }
  tmPaperSecs(r){
    const rec=(r.msgs||[]).find(m=>m.widget==='record');
    const ref=(r.msgs||[]).find(m=>m.widget==='refused');
    const rows=rec? rec.record.rows : [];
    const get=k=>{ const f=rows.find(x=>x[0]===k); return f? f[1] : null; };
    const out=[];
    out.push({key:'a', k:'Abstract', v:(r.obj||'A trained model')+', adapted from '+((get('Baseline')||r.baseline||'a licence-verified baseline').split(' \u00b7')[0])+' inside the estate. '+this.tmReportLead(r)});
    if(get('Objective')) out.push({key:'o', k:'Objective', v:get('Objective')});
    if(get('Baseline')||r.baseline) out.push({key:'b', k:'Baseline', v:get('Baseline')||r.baseline});
    if(get('Recipe')) out.push({key:'m', k:'Method', v:get('Recipe')});
    const mat=[get('Data classes'), get('Volumes')].filter(Boolean).join(' \u00b7 ');
    if(mat) out.push({key:'d', k:'Material', v:mat});
    if(get('Six checks')) out.push({key:'r', k:'Results against minimums', v:get('Six checks')});
    if(ref) out.push({key:'f', k:'Outcome', v:'Refused at acceptance. '+ref.reason});
    const ct=[get('Cost'), get('Time')].filter(Boolean).join(' \u00b7 ');
    if(ct) out.push({key:'c', k:'Cost and time against estimate', v:ct});
    out.push({key:'p', k:'Where it came from', v:'Every source named above is licence-verified and carries its rights class. Weights stayed on the internal cluster, and nothing was redistributed outside the estate.'});
    return out;
  }

      const fin = this.TM_FINISHED.indexOf(r.status)>=0;

  tmNewModel = () => this.setState(st=>{
    const k = this.tmKey(st);
    const ex = k==='exRuns', sk = k==='skRuns';
    const id = (sk? 'SKL-' : (ex? 'EXT-' : 'TRN-'))+String((sk? 10 : (ex? 20 : 23)) + st[k].filter(r=>r.status==='Shaping').length);
    const n = st[k].filter(r=>/^Untitled run/.test(r.name)).length;
    return {tmSel:id, tmComposer:'', [k]:[{id, name: n? 'Untitled run '+n : 'Untitled run', status:'Shaping', unread:0, objective:null,
      kind: sk? 'skill' : (ex? 'extract' : 'train'), obj:'Objective still forming',
      msgs:[{role:'akki', mins:0, text: sk? 'What do you want this skill to do?' : (ex? 'What do you want this extraction to produce?' : 'What do you want this model to do?')}]}, ...st[k]]};

  tmSend = () => {
    const t = (this.state.tmComposer||'').trim(); if(!t) return;
    this.setState(st=>{ const k=this.tmKey(st); return {tmComposer:'', [k]: st[k].map(r=>{
      if(r.id!==st.tmSel) return r;
      let msgs = r.msgs.concat([{role:'user', mins:0, text:t}]);
      let obj = r.objective || null, name = r.name;
      if(r.status==='Testing' && r.chk){
        const W=['none','One','Two','Three','Four','Five','Six'];
        const st=r.chk.filter(c=>c.s==='settled').length, me=r.chk.filter(c=>c.s==='measuring').length, pe=r.chk.filter(c=>c.s==='pending').length;
        const parts=[]; if(me) parts.push(W[me].toLowerCase()+' still measuring'); if(pe) parts.push(W[pe].toLowerCase()+' not started yet');
        msgs = msgs.concat([{role:'akki', mins:0, text: st===6?
          'All six settled, every one above its minimum.' :
          (W[st]+' of six settled so far, all comfortably above their minimums'+(parts.length? ' \u2014 '+parts.join(' and ')+'.' : '.'))}]);
        return {...r, msgs};
      }
      if(this.TM_FINISHED.indexOf(r.status)>=0){
        msgs = msgs.concat([{role:'akki', mins:0, text:'This model is already on the record, so nothing here can be edited in place. A change becomes a new version in the same version history, and this one carries on untouched.'},
                            {role:'akki', mins:0, text:'', widget:'remodel'}]);
        return {...r, msgs};
      }
      if(r.status==='In training' && r.tElapsed!=null){
        const cps = Math.min(5, Math.floor(r.tElapsed/120)+1);
        msgs = msgs.concat([{role:'akki', mins:0, text:'Running clean \u2014 '+this.tmDur(r.tElapsed)+' elapsed, about '+this.tmDur(r.tLeft)+' left on the current estimate. '+cps+' of 5 checkpoints written, no issues so far.'}]);
        return {...r, msgs};
      }
      if(r.status==='Queued'){
        const ord = n=>({1:'1st',2:'2nd',3:'3rd',4:'4th',5:'5th'}[n]||n+'th');
        msgs = msgs.concat([{role:'akki', mins:0, text: r.qPos?
          ('Yes \u2014 still '+ord(r.qPos)+', about '+r.qMins+' minutes until start. The run ahead of you has roughly '+Math.max(2, Math.round(r.qMins/r.qPos))+' minutes left on its last checkpoint.') :
          'A slot has just opened \u2014 training is starting now.'}]);
        return {...r, msgs};
      }
      if(r.status==='Shaping'){
        if(r.mode==='continue'){
          msgs = msgs.concat([{role:'akki', mins:0, text:'Recorded against this run. Nothing is frozen and no compute is spent yet.'}]);
          return {...r, msgs};
        }
        if(r.ready) return {...r, msgs};
        if(r.step5!=null){
          const nm = this.tmC(r,'STAGE5_NAME');
          msgs = msgs.concat([{role:'akki', mins:0, text:'Done, '+nm+' it is. Everything above is set now. Ready when you are.'}]);
          return {...r, name:nm, msgs, ready:true};
        }
        if(r.step4!=null){
          if(r.step4===0){
            msgs = msgs.concat([{role:'akki', mins:0, text: r.kind==='extract'?
              'These numbers come from those three sources. Add or drop one and I\u2019ll work them out again before you commit to anything.' : r.kind==='skill'?
              'These numbers come from those three sources and the four steps. Change either and I\u2019ll work them out again before you commit to anything.' :
              'These numbers come from '+(r.baseline||'that starting model')+' and the data. Change either and I\u2019ll work them out again before you commit to anything.'}]);
            return {...r, msgs, step4:1};
          }
          msgs = msgs.concat([{role:'akki', mins:0, text:'One last thing. I\u2019d call this '+this.tmC(r,'STAGE5_NAME')+', going by what it does and where it starts from. Keep that, or name it yourself?'}]);
          return {...r, msgs, step5:0};
        }
        if(r.baseline){
          const i3 = r.step3 || 0;
          const ST3 = this.tmC(r,'STAGE3');
          if(i3 < ST3.length){
            const s3 = ST3[i3];
            msgs = msgs.concat([{role:'akki', mins:0, text:s3.text, widget:s3.widget}]);
            return {...r, msgs, step3:i3+1};
          }
          if(!r.s4){
            msgs = msgs.concat([{role:'akki', mins:0, text:'Here\u2019s what you\u2019d be committing to.', widget:'reflect'}]);
            return {...r, msgs, s4:true, step4:0};
          }
          return {...r, msgs};
        }
        const step = r.step || 0;
        const nx = this.tmC(r,'STAGE1')[step];
        if(!nx) return {...r, msgs};
        msgs = msgs.concat([{role:'akki', mins:0, text:nx.text, widget:nx.widget, think:nx.think}]);
        const out = {...r, msgs, step:step+1};
        if(nx.widget==='baseline'){ out.bl = this.tmBaselines({statement:'classify counterparty contracts as certified, missing certification, or unclear'});
          out.obj = 'Counterparty contract certification, EN and SW'; }
        if(nx.widget==='sources'){ out.step3 = 0;
          if(r.kind==='skill'){ out.baseline = 'the decision log'; out.obj = 'Triage inbound contracts into three queues'; }
          else { out.baseline = 'the certification register'; out.obj = 'Certification status per live counterparty contract, CSV'; } }
        return out;
      }
      return {...r, name, msgs, objective:obj};
    })}; });
  };

  statsFromUsage(u){ if(!u) return []; return String(u).split(/\s*\u00b7\s*/).map(f=>f.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,3).map(f=>{ const m=f.match(/^([0-9][0-9.,]*%?|[A-Z][A-Za-z]+)\b\s*(.*)$/); return (m && m[2])? {v:m[1], l:m[2]} : {v:'\u2022', l:f}; }); }
  dwAction(act){ return () => { if(act && act.indexOf('walk:')===0){ const cur=this.state.dw||{}; const row={...(cur.srcRow||{}), go:act, walkLast:null}; this.setState({dw:this.estRowDW(row, cur.srcKind||'gov'), walkOpenCard:null, walkChecked:false}); return; }

  estStateBg(st){ return /^(Blocked|Violated|Disagreement|Certain|Marked|Held|Refused|Revoked|Denied|Declined|Failed)$/.test(st)? 'rgba(184,57,91,.10)'
    : /^(Counting down|Waiting for signature|Notable|Friction|Flagged|Waiting on you|Open|Ready to adopt|Widened|Hedged|Expired)$/.test(st)? 'rgba(176,141,46,.13)'

    : /^(Counting down|Waiting for signature|Notable|Friction|Flagged|Waiting on you|Open|Ready to adopt|Widened|Hedged|Expired)$/.test(st)? 'var(--brass)'

  ruBadgeLabel(st){ return st==='Waiting for signature'?'Needs Signature':st==='Applied'?'Enforced':st; }
  rbCatsFor(scope){
    const st=this.state, key=n=>(n||'').toLowerCase().split(' ')[0], rows=this.ruRows(), ov=st.ruOv||{};
    if(scope!=='pending') return RB_CATS.map(c=>({...c, rules: c.rules.map(ru=>{ const ch=rows.find(x=>x.ruleId===ru.id && /^(Waiting for signature|Counting down)$/.test(x.state)); return ch? {...ru, marker: ch.state==='Counting down'?'Change counting down':'Change proposed'} : ru; })
      .concat(rows.filter(x=>x.ruleKind==='proposal' && !x.recId && key(x.cat)===key(c.name) && (/^(Waiting for signature|Counting down)$/.test(x.state) || (x.state==='Enforced' && (x.autoDone || ov[x.ref])))).map(x=>({ id:'ru-'+x.ref, isRu:true, ruRef:x.ref, text:x.card2Text||x.text,
        bind: x.state==='Waiting for signature'?'Proposed':x.state==='Counting down'?'Counting down':(x.binding||'Ordinary'),
        meta: x.state==='Waiting for signature'? ('Proposed by '+(x.s1?x.s1.n:x.lb)+' \u00b7 '+x.ref+' \u00b7 waiting for a second signature in Rules Updates') : x.state==='Counting down'? ('Countersigned by '+(x.s2?x.s2.n:'')+' \u00b7 '+x.ref+' \u00b7 takes effect '+x.effect) : (x.ref+' \u00b7 '+(x.ver||'v1')+' \u00b7 enforced '+x.enforced+' \u00b7 re-verified'),
        promise:'', feel:'', facts:'' }))) }));

      const bind = !adopted[r.id] ? 'Recommended' : (!x || x.state==='Waiting for signature') ? 'Proposed' : x.state==='Counting down' ? 'Counting down' : (x.binding||'Ordinary');
      const meta = !adopted[r.id] ? (r.kind+' \u00b7 '+r.reason) : (!x || x.state==='Waiting for signature') ? ('Proposed '+adopted[r.id]+' \u00b7 waiting for a second signature in Rules Updates') : x.state==='Counting down' ? ('Countersigned by '+(x.s2?x.s2.n:'')+' \u00b7 takes effect '+x.effect) : ('Enforced '+x.enforced+' \u00b7 '+x.ref+' \u00b7 re-verified');
      return { id:r.id, isRec:true, rec:r, text: drafts[r.id]||r.text, bind, edited: !!drafts[r.id] && drafts[r.id]!==r.text, meta }; }) }));

  chgParse(x){ return x ? (Date.parse(String(x).replace(' at ',' ').replace('a.m.','AM').replace('p.m.','PM'))||0) : 0; }
  chgNorm(r){ return { ...r, lb: r.lb||r.by||'', verPrev: r.verPrev||r.ver1||'', ver: r.ver2||r.ver||'',
      s1: r.s1 || (r.by? {n:r.by, at:r.when||''} : null), s2: r.s2 || (r.signoffBy? {n:r.signoffBy, at:r.signoffDate||''} : null),
      effect: r.effect || (r.cdEffective||'').replace(/^Effective /,''), enforced: r.enforced || r.resolvedDate || '',
      resDate: r.resDate||r.resolvedDate||'', resBy: r.resBy||r.resolvedBy||'', resReason: r.resReason || (r.s1? '' : (r.reason||'')),
      state: r.state==='Applied' ? 'Enforced' : r.state }; }
  chgStatus(r0){ const r=this.chgNorm(r0), st=r.state, now=this.ruNow(), DAY=86400000;
    if(st==='Waiting for signature'){ const n=Math.max(0, Math.floor((now-this.chgParse(r.at))/DAY)); return 'Needs a second signature \u00b7 waiting '+n+(n===1?' day':' days'); }
    if(st==='Counting down'){ const rel=this.chgRel(r.effect); return 'Takes effect '+r.effect+(rel? ' \u00b7 '+rel : ''); }
    if(st==='Enforced') return r.ruleKind==='listAdd' ? ('Added by '+r.lb+' \u00b7 no countersignature \u2014 additions take effect immediately'+(r.ackBy? ' \u00b7 Acknowledged '+r.ackDate+' by '+r.ackBy : '')) : ('Enforced '+r.enforced+' \u2014 now filed under '+r.cat);
    if(st==='Declared') return 'Declared '+r.resDate+' \u2014 on the register';
    if(st==='Granted') return 'Granted '+r.resDate;
    if(st==='Declined') return 'Declined '+r.resDate+' by '+r.resBy;
    if(st==='Cancelled') return r.withdrawn ? ('Withdrawn '+r.resDate+' by '+r.resBy+' \u2014 before a second signature') : ('Cancelled '+r.resDate+' by '+r.resBy);
    return r.ruleLine||r.meta||''; }
  chgRel(eff){ const diff=this.chgParse(eff)-this.ruNow(); if(diff<=0) return ''; const d=Math.floor(diff/86400000), h=Math.round((diff%86400000)/3600000);
    return 'in '+(d? d+(d===1?' day':' days')+(h? ' '+h+' h':'') : h+(h===1?' hour':' hours')); }
  ruleRowDW(r0){
    const r=this.chgNorm(r0), st=r.state, k=r.ruleKind, now=this.ruNow();

    const isWait=st==='Waiting for signature', isCD=st==='Counting down', pending=isWait||isCD, enforced=st==='Enforced';
    const active = this.ruIsOpen(r0);
    const q=t=>t? ('\u201c'+t+'\u201d') : '';
    const dateOnly=x=>(x||'').split(' at ')[0];
    const SAGE='var(--sage)', OX='var(--oxblood)', INK='var(--ink2)', BRASS='var(--brass)';
    const c={ isProposal:k==='proposal', isTwoCard:k==='change'||k==='listRemove', isListAdd:k==='listAdd', isClass:k==='class',
      p1Title: k==='proposal' ? (enforced?'What Was Added':'The Proposal') : k==='listAdd' ? 'What Was Added' : k==='class' ? 'The Declaration' : 'What Changes',
      text:r.card2Text||'', pills:[r.cat, r.binding].filter(Boolean).map((p,i)=>({key:'p'+i, label:p})),
      reason:q(r.reason), hasReason:!!r.reason,
      proposedLine: r.lb ? ('Proposed by '+r.lb+' on '+dateOnly(r.at)) : '',
      enforcedMono: enforced ? (r.ref+' \u00b7 '+r.ver+' \u00b7 enforced '+r.enforced) : '', hasEnforcedMono: enforced && !!r.ref,
      entry:r.entry||'', listRuleLine: r.listRule ? ('The list rule: '+r.listRule) : '', hasListRule: !!r.listRule && k!=='listAdd',

    else { c.c1Label=enforced?'Previous Rule':'Current Rule'; c.c1Text=r.card1Text||''; c.c1Mono=r.ref+' \u00b7 '+r.verPrev;

    const lines=[]; let sigs=[];
    const sig=(x,lbl)=> x ? {key:lbl, done:true, mark:'\u2713', border:SAGE, label:x.n+' \u2014 '+lbl, when:x.at} : {key:lbl, done:false, mark:'', border:'var(--line)', label:'Second signature \u2014 not yet given', when:''};

    else { lines.push({key:'l0', text:this.chgStatus(r0), color: st==='Declined'? OX : INK}); }
    c.resLines=lines; c.sigs=sigs; c.hasSigs=sigs.length>0;
    c.resReason = (!pending && !enforced && st!=='Declared') ? q(r.resReason) : ''; c.hasResReason=!!c.resReason;
    c.hasStamp=enforced; c.stamp = enforced ? ('Enforced \u00b7 '+r.enforced+(r.ref? ' \u00b7 '+r.ref+' '+r.ver : '')) : '';
    c.btnColor = active? 'var(--blue)' : '#b9b3a6'; c.btnCursor = active? 'pointer' : 'default';
    c.showRuBtn = active; c.onBtn = active ? (()=>this.ruArrive(r0.ref||r0.segment)) : (()=>{});
    c.showArrow = true; c.isCDTwo = isCD && c.isTwoCard; c.isOldTwo = !isCD && c.isTwoCard;
    if(c.isCDTwo){ const A=(c.c1Text||'').split(' '), Bw=(c.c2Text||'').split(' '); let i=0; while(i<A.length&&i<Bw.length&&A[i]===Bw[i]) i++;
      let j=0; while(j<A.length-i&&j<Bw.length-i&&A[A.length-1-j]===Bw[Bw.length-1-j]) j++;
      const pre=A.slice(0,i).join(' '), suf=A.slice(A.length-j).join(' '), m1=A.slice(i,A.length-j).join(' '), m2=Bw.slice(i,Bw.length-j).join(' ');
      const seg=(pfx,mid,bg,col)=>[{text:pre?pre+' ':'',bg:'transparent',color:'var(--ink)',pad:'0'},{text:mid,bg,color:col,pad:'1px 4px'},{text:suf?' '+suf:'',bg:'transparent',color:'var(--ink)',pad:'0'}].filter(x=>x.text).map((x,k)=>({...x,key:pfx+k}));
      c.segs1=seg('a',m1,'rgba(184,57,91,.12)','var(--oxblood)'); c.segs2=seg('b',m2,'rgba(29,122,110,.13)','var(--sage)');
      c.cdTop1='Current'; c.cdTop2='From '+(r.effect||'').split(' at ')[0];
      c.cdRef1=r.ref+' \u00b7 '+(r.verPrev||'v1')+(r.since? ' \u00b7 in force since '+r.since : ''); c.cdRef2=r.ref+' \u00b7 '+r.ver+' \u00b7 takes effect '+(r.effect||'').split(' at ')[0]; }
    return { title:r.text, sub:(r.mc||r.cls||'')+' \u00b7 Logged by '+r.lb+' \u00b7 '+r.at,
      chip:{label:this.ruBadgeLabel(st), bg:this.estStateBg(st), color:this.estStateColor(st)},
      isRuleRow:true, chg:c, segment:r.segment||'RS-0000', verifiedDate:r.verifiedDate||'', actions:[] }; }
  estStandBg(st){ return st==='Marked'?'rgba(184,57,91,.10)':st==='Forming'?'rgba(176,141,46,.13)':st==='Reduced'?'rgba(58,90,140,.10)':'rgba(29,122,110,.12)'; }
  estStandColor(st){ return st==='Marked'?'var(--oxblood)':st==='Forming'?'var(--brass)':st==='Reduced'?'var(--blue)':'var(--sage)'; }
  estBasisLabel(st, isGm){ if(isGm){ return st==='Refused'?'The rule that stopped it'
      : /^(Certain|Marked|Held)$/.test(st)?'Why we are certain'
      : /^(Flagged|Notable)$/.test(st)?'Basis of suspicion'
      : st==='Waiting on you'?'Why it needs a person'
      : /^(Contained|In the copy|Standing)$/.test(st)?'What is happening now'
      : st==='Released'?'How it ended':'What this means'; }
    return /^(Blocked|Violated)$/.test(st)?'The rule that stopped it'
      : st==='Disagreement'?'Why it needs a person'
      : /^(Counting down|Waiting for signature|Cancelled)$/.test(st)?'Where it is in the sign-off process'
      : /^(Hard line|Permission|Ordinary|Managed list)$/.test(st)?'How binding this is'
      : st==='Proven working'?'What was proven':'What this means'; }
  estBasis(st, isGm){ const M={
    'The rule that stopped it':'A rule refused this before anything left masked. The block names its rule and its reason to the person who asked \u2014 nothing is refused silently.',
    'Why it needs a person':'Two authorities reached different verdicts. One person decides in writing, and both accounts stay on the record either way.',
    'Where it is in the sign-off process':'This change is mid-sign-off process. Nothing takes effect until its countdown ends, and it can be cancelled right up until it does.',
    'How binding this is':'This is a standing rule. How binding it is decides whether it can be changed at all, and by what path.',
    'What was proven':'A hard line was tested against itself and held. The attempt and the refusal together are the certificate.',
    'Why we are certain':'This is certain, not a guess. It reached for something no honest path reaches, and the reach itself is the evidence.',
    'Basis of suspicion':'Nothing here is proven. It is behaviour that does not match what this actor is here to do \u2014 kept and watched, not acted on.',
    'What is happening now':'This is held on a timer while a person looks. Nothing is permanent, and it releases on its own if nothing else arrives.',
    'How it ended':'This was held, then released when the timer ran out and nothing else arrived. The held work was restored.'
  }; return M[this.estBasisLabel(st,isGm)]||''; }
  standingLine(st){ return st==='Settled'?'Trust has settled \u2014 conduct has matched the declaration over time.'
    : st==='Forming'?'Still forming \u2014 new here, so ordinary checks stay firm until a pattern is clear.'
    : st==='Reduced'?'Reduced \u2014 recent conduct drifted from the declaration, so checks are firmer for now.'
    : st==='Marked'?'Marked \u2014 flagged for conduct that every door now checks. Clearing it takes two signatures.':''; }
  estActions(r, kind, walkKey){ if(kind==='gm'){
      if(walkKey==='bait' || r.state==='Marked') return [{label:'Open marks & baits \u2192', act:'marked'}];
      if(r.state==='In the copy') return [{label:'Open the copy session \u2192', act:'session', kind:'primary'}];

      return []; }
    if(/^(Counting down|Waiting for signature|Cancelled)$/.test(r.state) || r.lane==='Changes') return [{label:'Open in Rules Updates \u2192', act:'gov-updates', kind:'primary'}];
    return []; }
  estRowDW(r, kind){ if(r.ruleKind) return this.ruleRowDW(r);
    const isGm=kind==='gm';
    if(r.state==='Allowed' && (r.shape==='grant'||r.shape==='conduct')){
      return { title:r.text, sub:r.mc+' \u00b7 Logged by '+r.lb+' \u00b7 '+r.at, chip:{label:'ALLOWED', bg:this.estStateBg('Allowed'), color:this.estStateColor('Allowed')},
        isAllowedB:true, isGrantB:r.shape==='grant', isConductB:r.shape==='conduct', grantTitle:r.grantTitle||'', grantCaps:(r.grantCaps||[]).map((t,i)=>({key:'gc'+i,text:t})), whoSetIt:r.whoSetIt||[], conductProse:r.conductProse||'', actions:[],
        segment:r.segment||'RS-0000', verifiedDate:r.verifiedDate||'' }; }
    const isBlocked = r.state==='Blocked' && !!r.ref, isAllowed = r.state==='Allowed' && !!r.ref, isViolated = r.state==='Violated' && !!r.ref;
    if(isBlocked || isAllowed || isViolated){
      const who=r.who||'', when=r.when||r.count||'';

      return { title:r.text, sub: (isViolated? (r.cls||r.mc) : r.mc) ? ((isViolated? (r.cls||r.mc) : r.mc)+' \u00b7 Logged by '+(r.lb||who)+' \u00b7 '+(r.at||when)) : (who? ('Logged by '+who+(when? (' \u00b7 '+when):'')) : when),
        chip:{label: isBlocked? 'BLOCKED' : isAllowed? 'ALLOWED' : r.state, bg:this.estStateBg(r.state), color:this.estStateColor(r.state)},
        isBlocked, isAllowed, isViolated, isBC, actions:[],
        ruleCard:{ text:r.ruleLine||r.meta, ref:r.ref||'', ver:r.ver||'', enforced:r.enforced||'', category:r.category||'' }, oneLiner: isBC? (r.ruleLine||'') : '', ruleProposal: !!r.ruleProposal,
        whoSetIt: r.whoSetIt||[], founding:r.founding||'',

        reviewedBy:r.reviewedBy||'', reviewDate:r.reviewDate||'', decision:r.meta||r.decision||'',
        receiptCard: false, receiptLine:r.receiptLine||'A receipt was issued for this crossing.', receiptMono:r.receiptMono||'',
        segment:r.segment||'RS-0000', verifiedDate:r.verifiedDate||'' }; }
    if(r.state==='Disagreement'){
      return { title:r.text, sub: r.tagLine || ((r.actId?r.actId+' \u00b7 ':'')+(r.when||r.count||'')),
        chip:{label:'DISAGREEMENT', bg:this.estStateBg('Disagreement'), color:this.estStateColor('Disagreement')},
        isDisagreement:true, resolved:!!r.resolved, actions: r.resolved ? [] : [{label:'Open in Response \u2192', act:'response', kind:'primary'}],
        decisionText:r.decisionText||'', decisionNote:r.decisionNote||'', decisionSigners:r.decisionSigners||[], decisionClose:r.decisionClose||'', decisionSegmentLine:r.decisionSegmentLine||'',
        rulesSide:r.rulesSide||[], secSide:r.secSide||[],
        segment:r.segment||'RS-0000', verifiedDate:r.verifiedDate||'' }; }
    if(/^(Proven working|Failed)$/.test(r.state)){
      const pass = r.state!=='Failed';
      const steps = HARD_LINE_TESTS.map((t,i)=>{ const full = t.gate+(t.qualifier? ' '+t.qualifier : ''); const isFail = !pass && r.failedGate===full;
        return { key:'hlt'+i, n:i+1, gate:t.gate, qualifier:t.qualifier||'', attempt:t.attempt, result: isFail?'did not hold':'held',
          resultBg: isFail?'rgba(184,57,91,.10)':'rgba(29,122,110,.12)', resultColor: isFail?'var(--oxblood)':'var(--sage)' }; });
      return { title:r.text, sub:r.count||r.when||'',
        chip:{label:r.state, bg:this.estStateBg(r.state), color:this.estStateColor(r.state)},
        isHardLineTest:true, hltPass:pass,
        hltIntro: pass? 'A hard line that can\u2019t be shown working isn\u2019t trusted to be working. Each hard line was tested against itself \u2014 attempted, and refused. The attempt and the refusal together are the certificate.'
          : 'A hard line that can\u2019t be shown working isn\u2019t trusted to be working. Each hard line was tested against itself \u2014 attempted, and did not hold.',
        hltSteps: steps, hltCert: r.certId||'', actions:[] }; }
    const walkKey=(r.go||'').indexOf('walk:')===0? r.go.slice(5):null;
    const opens=(r.go||'').indexOf('toast:')===0? r.go.slice(6):null;
    const w=walkKey? WALKS[walkKey]:null;
    const who=isGm? (r.actor||''):(r.cls||''); const when=isGm? (r.when||''):(r.count||'');
    const sub=[who,when].filter(Boolean).join(' \u00b7 ');
    let cards;
    if(w){ cards=w.cards; }
    else { cards=[{q:'What happened', a:r.text, working: r.meta? [r.meta]:null}];
      const bt=this.estBasis(r.state,isGm); if(bt) cards.push({q:this.estBasisLabel(r.state,isGm), a:bt});
      if(opens) cards.push({q:'What opening this shows', a:opens}); }
    const isCD = r.state==='Counting down';
    let cdRemaining='';
    if(isCD){ cdRemaining=r.count||''; if(/ago\s*$/i.test(cdRemaining)) cdRemaining=cdRemaining.replace(/\s*ago\s*$/i,'').trim()+' left'; else if(cdRemaining && !/left/i.test(cdRemaining)) cdRemaining+=' left'; }
    const isGrant = r.cls==='Grant';
    const acts = isGrant ? [] : this.estActions(r,kind,walkKey);
    if(r.walkLast) acts.push({label:'Walk the model call \u2192', act:'walk:'+r.walkLast});
    return { title:r.text, sub, chip: r.state? {label:r.state, bg:this.estStateBg(r.state), color:this.estStateColor(r.state)}:null,
      cards, broken: w? !!w.broken:false, actions:acts, isCountdown: isCD, cdRemaining, isWaitingSig: r.state==='Waiting for signature' && !isGrant, srcRow:r, srcKind:kind }; }
  personDW(p){ return { title:p.who, sub:p.meta,
    chip:{label:p.standing, bg:this.estStandBg(p.standing), color:this.estStandColor(p.standing)},
    cards:[ {q:'What they touch', a:'Data accessed '+p.data+' \u00b7 model calls '+p.models+' \u00b7 PII exposure '+p.pii+'.'},
      {q:'Standing', a:this.standingLine(p.standing)},
      {q:'What the full profile holds', a:'Everything they accessed, the models they used, what they downloaded, their declaration and when it was last set, the rights they hold and who counter-signed each, their standing, any mark with its reason, and their ledger entries.'} ],
    actions: p.marked? [{label:'Open marks & baits \u2192', act:'marked'}] : [] }; }
  estGroupsView(kind, tab, cur){ const list=(EST_GROUPS[kind]||{})[tab]||[];
    return list.map(g=>{ const sel=cur===g.f; const t=this.estTone(g.tone, sel);
      return { label:g.label, count:g.count, blurb:g.blurb, selected:sel,
        onClick: kind==='gov'? this.setGovFilter(sel?'All':g.f) : kind==='trust'? this.setTsFilter(sel?'All':g.f) : this.setGmFilter(sel?'All':g.f),
        bg:t.bg, border:t.border, accent:t.accent, countColor:t.count }; }); }
  estTone(t, sel){ const A=t==='w'?'var(--brass)':t==='g'?'var(--sage)':t==='b'?'var(--oxblood)':'var(--blue)';
    const tint=t==='w'?'rgba(176,141,46,.10)':t==='g'?'rgba(29,122,110,.09)':t==='b'?'rgba(184,57,91,.08)':'rgba(22,39,74,.06)';
    return {accent:A, count:A, bg: sel? tint:'#fff', border: sel? A:'var(--line)'}; }
  setRulesTab(t){ return () => this.setState({rulesTab:t}); }
  setRegTab(t){ return () => this.setState({regTab:t, measuredPageOpen:false, mixOpen:false}); }
  regChartChange = (e) => this.setState({regChart:e.target.value});
  toggleGpu(id){ return () => this.setState(st=>({gpuOpen: st.gpuOpen===id? null : id})); }
  toggleLlmRow(id){ return () => this.setState(st=>({llmOpen: st.llmOpen===id? null : id})); }
  toggleLlmCards = () => this.setState(st=> st.llmCardsOpen ? {llmCardsOpen:false} : {llmCardsOpen:true, llmCostOpen:false, llmCareOpen:false, llmGraphsOpen:false});
  toggleLlmCost = () => this.setState(st=> st.llmCostOpen ? {llmCostOpen:false} : {llmCostOpen:true, llmCardsOpen:false, llmCareOpen:false, llmGraphsOpen:false});
  toggleLlmCare = () => this.setState(st=> st.llmCareOpen ? {llmCareOpen:false} : {llmCareOpen:true, llmCardsOpen:false, llmCostOpen:false, llmGraphsOpen:false});
  toggleCensusRead = () => this.setState(st=> st.censusReadOpen ? {censusReadOpen:false} : {censusReadOpen:true, censusCareOpen:false, censusMixOpen:false, censusHowOpen:false});
  toggleCensusCare = () => this.setState(st=> st.censusCareOpen ? {censusCareOpen:false} : {censusCareOpen:true, censusReadOpen:false, censusMixOpen:false, censusHowOpen:false});
  toggleCensusMix = () => this.setState(st=> st.censusMixOpen ? {censusMixOpen:false} : {censusMixOpen:true, censusReadOpen:false, censusCareOpen:false, censusHowOpen:false});
  toggleLlmGraphs = () => this.setState(st=> st.llmGraphsOpen ? {llmGraphsOpen:false} : {llmGraphsOpen:true, llmCardsOpen:false, llmCostOpen:false, llmCareOpen:false});
  viewAllModelsStop = (e) => { if(e && e.stopPropagation) e.stopPropagation(); this.openModelRecord(); };
  setFlowFilter(l){ return () => this.setState({flowFilter:l}); }
  setLlmFilter(l){ return () => this.setState({llmFilter:l}); }
  openConnect = () => this.setState({connectOpen:true, connectChat:{
    messages:[{from:'akki', text:'What would you like to connect? Tell me in your own words \u2014 a data source, a model, or compute. If you already know how it should reach us, say that too.'}],
    input:'', stage:'kind', kind:null, method:null, cred:null, name:'', attempt:0, status:null, diagnostics:[], rights:null, capacityNote:'', pendingDuplicate:null, pendingIdentity:null, rejectReason:null
  }});
  closeConnect = () => this.setState(st=>({connectOpen:false, connectChat:{...st.connectChat, status:null}}));
  openWiz(key){ return () => this.setState({wiz:{key, step:0, answers:{}, input:'', done:false,
    messages:[{from:'akki', text:WIZ[key].opener}]}}); }
  closeWiz = () => this.setState({wiz:null});
  wizInputChange = (e) => this.setState(st=>({wiz:{...st.wiz, input:e.target.value}}));
  wizInputKeyDown = (e) => { if(e.key==='Enter' && !e.shiftKey){ e.preventDefault(); this.wizSend(); } };
  wizSend = () => { const t=((this.state.wiz||{}).input||'').trim(); if(t) this.wizSay(t); };
  wizChip(text){ return () => this.wizSay(text); }
  wizSay(text){
    const st = this.state.wiz; if(!st || st.done) return;
    const cfg = WIZ[st.key]; let w = {...st, input:'', messages: st.messages.concat([{from:'user', text}])};
    const step = cfg.steps[w.step];
    if(step && step.guard){ const g = step.guard(text); if(g){ w.messages = w.messages.concat([{from:'akki', text:g}]); this.setState({wiz:w}); return; } }
    if(step && step.key==='confirm'){
      if(/change/i.test(text)){
        w = {...w, step:0, answers:{}, messages: w.messages.concat([{from:'akki', text:cfg.opener}])};
        this.setState({wiz:w}); return;
      }
      w.done = true; w.messages = w.messages.concat([{from:'akki', text:cfg.done(w.answers)}]);
      this.setState({wiz:w}); this.setToast(cfg.toast); return;
    }
    if(step) w.answers = {...w.answers, [step.key]:text};
    w.step = w.step + 1;
    const next = cfg.steps[w.step];
    if(next) w.messages = w.messages.concat([{from:'akki', text: typeof next.ask==='function'? next.ask(w.answers) : next.ask}]);
    this.setState({wiz:w});
  }
  connectInputChange = (e) => this.setState(st=>({connectChat:{...st.connectChat, input:e.target.value}}));
  connectInputKeyDown = (e) => { if(e.key==='Enter' && !e.shiftKey){ e.preventDefault(); this.connectSend(); } };
  connectSend = () => { const t=(this.state.connectChat.input||'').trim(); if(!t) return; this.connectSay(t); };
  connectChip(text){ return () => this.connectSay(text); }
  cPush(c, from, text){ return {...c, messages: c.messages.concat([{from, text}])}; }
  connectSay(text){
    let c = {...this.state.connectChat};
    c = this.cPush(c, 'user', text);
    c.input = '';
    const t = text.toLowerCase();
    const say = (msg) => { c = this.cPush(c, 'akki', msg); };

    if(c.stage === 'kind'){
      const kind = /llm|language model|claude|gpt|sonnet/.test(t) ? 'llm'
        : /trained|fine.?tune|classifier|embedding|weights|our model/.test(t) ? 'model'
        : /compute|gpu|cluster|hardware|a100/.test(t) ? 'compute'
        : /data|archive|database|mailbox|calls|logs|records|source/.test(t) ? 'data' : null;
      if(!kind){ say("I couldn't tell which of the four you mean. Is it a data source, an LLM, a trained model, or compute?"); }
      else {
        c.kind = kind;
        const k = CONNECT_KINDS.find(x=>x.key===kind);
        c.stage = 'method';
        say(k.label.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+k.label.slice(1)+'. How should it reach us? '+k.methods.map(m=>m.label).join(', ')+' \u2014 or describe the arrangement you have.');
        const m = k.methods.find(mm=> t.includes(mm.label.toLowerCase().split(' ')[0]));
        if(m){ this.connectApplyMethod(c, k, m, say, true); }
      }
    } else if(c.stage === 'method'){
      const k = CONNECT_KINDS.find(x=>x.key===c.kind);
      const m = k.methods.find(mm=> t.includes(mm.label.toLowerCase().split(' ')[0])) || k.methods.find(mm=> t.includes(mm.key));
      if(!m){
        const unsupported = CONNECT_UNSUPPORTED.find(u=>u.re.test(t));
        if(unsupported){ c.stage='notSupported'; c.status='notSupported'; say(unsupported.label+' isn\u2019t a connector we support yet \u2014 nothing was attempted.'); }
        else{ say('I can work with '+k.methods.map(x=>x.label).join(', ')+'. Which is closest to what you have?'); }
      }
      else { this.connectApplyMethod(c, k, m, say, false); }
    } else if(c.stage === 'capacity'){
      c.capacityNote = text.trim(); c.stage='name';
      say('Noted \u2014 sizing for that. What should this be called on the record?');
    } else if(c.stage === 'cred'){
      const cred = /issue|give|provide|mine|our/.test(t) ? 'issue' : /receive|mint|you (give|issue)|from you/.test(t) ? 'receive' : null;
      if(!cred){ say('Either works. Say "I will issue" if the credentials come from your side, or "I will receive" if we should mint them.'); }
      else { c.cred=cred; c.stage='name'; say((cred==='issue'? 'Good \u2014 send us a scoped service account when you are ready.' : 'Good \u2014 we will mint credentials and record who takes them.')+' What should this be called on the record?'); }
    } else if(c.stage === 'name'){
      c.name = text.trim();
      if(c.kind==='data'){
        const pool = this.state.connectSources.map(s=>s.name).concat((this.state.addedRows.measure||[]).map(a=>a.name));
        const dup = connectFindSimilar(c.name, pool);
        if(dup){ c.pendingDuplicate = dup; c.stage='duplicateName'; say('\u201c'+dup+'\u201d already looks similar to what you\u2019re naming \u2014 is this genuinely different, or the same source under a new name?'); }
        else { c.stage='rights'; say('What rights class should this carry \u2014 Internal Only, Restricted, or Regulatory Only?'); }
      } else {
        c.stage='confirm'; this.connectSayConfirm(c, say);
      }
    } else if(c.stage === 'duplicateName'){
      if(/use the existing|existing|same/.test(t)){ c.status='usedExisting'; c.stage='done'; say('Using the existing one \u2014 nothing new was written.'); }
      else if(/genuinely different|different|yes|new|distinct/.test(t)){ c.stage='rights'; say('Noted \u2014 treating this as a separate source. What rights class should it carry \u2014 Internal Only, Restricted, or Regulatory Only?'); }
      else { say('Is this genuinely different from \u201c'+c.pendingDuplicate+'\u201d, or should I use the existing one?'); }
    } else if(c.stage === 'rights'){
      const rc = CONNECT_RIGHTS.find(r => t.includes(r.label.toLowerCase()) || t.includes(r.key));
      if(!rc){ say('I need one of: Internal Only, Restricted, or Regulatory Only.'); }
      else { c.rights = rc.label; c.stage='confirm'; this.connectSayConfirm(c, say); }
    } else if(c.stage === 'confirm'){
      if(/change|back|no|different|instead/.test(t)){ c.stage='method'; c.method=null; say('Fine. How should it reach us instead?'); }
      else { return this.attemptConnect(c); }
    } else if(c.stage === 'notSupported'){
      if(/different|try|change|method/.test(t)){ c.stage='method'; c.method=null; c.status=null; say('Sure \u2014 how should it reach us instead?'); }
      else { say('That connector isn\u2019t supported yet. We can try a different method, or you can close this and raise it as a request.'); }
    } else if(c.stage === 'identityDuplicate'){
      if(/use the existing|existing/.test(t)){ c.status='usedExisting'; c.stage='done'; say('Using the existing one \u2014 nothing new was written.'); }
      else if(/truly new|genuinely new|new|distinct/.test(t)){
        const k = CONNECT_KINDS.find(x=>x.key===c.kind); const m = k.methods.find(x=>x.key===c.method);
        return this.finalizeData(c, k, m);
      }
      else { say('Use the existing one, or is this truly new?'); }
    } else if(c.stage === 'failed'){
      if(/retry|try again|again/.test(t)) return this.attemptConnect(c, true);
      if(/batch|schedule/.test(t)){ c.method='batch'; say('Switching to a scheduled batch drop. Say "connect" to try again.'); c.stage='confirm'; }
      else if(/service account|scoped|issue/.test(t)){ c.cred='issue'; say('Noted \u2014 a scoped service account from your side. Say "connect" to try again.'); c.stage='confirm'; }
      else if(/log|handshake|why|debug/.test(t)){ say('The handshake is above, step by step. The failing step is the one in red \u2014 fixing it is usually a matter of scope or route, not of the source itself.'); }
      else { say('We can retry as-is, change the credentials arrangement, or switch how it reaches us. Which?'); }
    }
    this.setState({connectChat:c});
  }
  connectApplyMethod(c, k, m, say, fromKindStage){
    c.method = m.key;
    if(k.key==='compute' && m.key==='akki'){ c.stage='capacity'; say((fromKindStage?'Noted \u2014 platform-allocated capacity. ':'')+m.note+' What kind of capacity needs are we sizing for?'); }
    else { c.stage='cred'; say((fromKindStage?'Noted \u2014 '+m.label.toLowerCase()+'. ':'')+m.note+' Will you be issuing credentials to us, or receiving credentials from us?'); }
  }
  connectSayConfirm(c, say){
    const k = CONNECT_KINDS.find(x=>x.key===c.kind); const m = k.methods.find(x=>x.key===c.method);
    const rightsBit = c.rights? ', rights class '+c.rights : '';
    const credBit = c.method==='akki'? ', capacity: '+(c.capacityNote||'unspecified') : ', credentials '+(c.cred==='issue'?'issued by you':'minted by us');
    say('Here is what I will attempt: '+c.name+', '+k.label.toLowerCase()+', over '+m.label.toLowerCase()+rightsBit+credBit+'. Say "connect" when you want me to try, or tell me what to change.');
  }
  attemptConnect(c0, isRetry){
    let c = {...c0, input:''};
    const k = CONNECT_KINDS.find(x=>x.key===c.kind);
    const m = k.methods.find(x=>x.key===c.method);
    c.attempt = (c.attempt||0) + 1;
    c = this.cPush(c, 'akki', 'Attempting the connection\u2026');
    // first attempt over a private link, or with credentials we mint, needs a second pass
    const willFail = c.attempt===1 && (c.method==='link' || c.method==='seam' || c.cred==='receive');
    if(willFail){
      c.status='failed'; c.stage='failed';
      c.diagnostics = [
        {step:'1/4', text:'Route reached '+(k.key==='compute'? 'the scheduler':'the estate')+'.', ok:true},
        {step:'2/4', text:'TLS handshake completed, certificate pinned.', ok:true},
        {step:'3/4', text: c.cred==='receive'? 'Credentials minted, but the source rejected them \u2014 no matching principal.' : 'Credentials accepted, scope too narrow to read the declared set.', ok:false},
        {step:'4/4', text:'Not attempted. Nothing was written, and nothing left masked.', ok:null}
      ];
      c = this.cPush(c, 'akki', 'Connection failed at step 3. '+(c.cred==='receive'? 'The source did not recognise the principal we minted.' : 'The account we were given cannot read what the declaration asks for.')+' Nothing left masked, and nothing was written. We can retry as-is, switch the credentials arrangement, or change how it reaches us.');
      this.setState({connectChat:c});
      return;
    }
    c.diagnostics = [];
    if(k.key==='data'){
      const alias = CONNECT_IDENTITY_ALIASES.find(a=>a.re.test(c.name));
      if(alias){
        c.stage='identityDuplicate'; c.status=null; c.pendingIdentity=alias.identity;
        c = this.cPush(c, 'akki', 'The handshake succeeded, but it resolved to the same account as \u201c'+alias.identity+'\u201d, already connected. Use the existing one, or is this truly new?');
        this.setState({connectChat:c});
        return;
      }
      return this.finalizeData(c, k, m);
    }
    if(k.key==='llm' || k.key==='model') return this.finalizeModel(c, k, m);
    // compute
    c.status='success'; c.stage='done';
    const capNote = c.capacityNote? ' Sized for: '+c.capacityNote+'.' : '';
    c = this.cPush(c, 'akki', 'Connection successful. Added to '+k.tabName+'. '+c.name+' is connected over '+m.label.toLowerCase()+'.'+capNote);
    const entry = { name:c.name, meta: k.label+' \u00b7 '+m.label+(c.capacityNote? ' \u00b7 '+c.capacityNote : '')+(c.method==='akki'? '' : ' \u00b7 '+(c.cred==='issue'?'credentials issued by you':'credentials minted by us'))+' \u00b7 not yet measured', badgeLabel:'Just connected', badgeBg:'rgba(29,122,110,.12)', badgeColor:'var(--sage)', platformAllocated: c.method==='akki', capacityNote: c.capacityNote||'',
      cardId: c.kind==='compute' ? 'gpu-0'+(5+(this.state.addedRows.compute||[]).length) : '',
      cardType: c.method==='akki' ? 'Akki-managed capacity' : m.label,
      cardSummary: (c.capacityNote? c.capacityNote : 'Sizing not stated')+' \u00b7 no slot of your own \u00b7 nothing running yet' };
    this.setState(st=>({ regTab:k.tab, addedRows:{...st.addedRows, [k.tab]: [entry].concat(st.addedRows[k.tab]||[])} }));
    this.setToast('Connected. '+c.name+' appears in '+k.tabName+'.');
    this.setState({connectChat:c});
  }
  finalizeData(c, k, m){
    c.status='success'; c.stage='done'; c.diagnostics=[];
    c = this.cPush(c, 'akki', 'Connection successful. Added to '+k.tabName+' \u2014 The estate, item by item. '+c.name+' is connected over '+m.label.toLowerCase()+'. It is unmeasured until the next census, and it is drawn that way.');
    const entry = { name:c.name, meta: k.label+' \u00b7 '+m.label+' \u00b7 '+(c.rights||'Internal Only')+' \u00b7 '+(c.cred==='issue'?'credentials issued by you':'credentials minted by us')+' \u00b7 not yet measured', badgeLabel:'Just connected', badgeBg:'rgba(29,122,110,.12)', badgeColor:'var(--sage)' };
    this.setState(st=>({ regTab:k.tab,
      connectSources:[{name:c.name, type:'Connected source', use:'Declared at connection', rights:c.rights||'Internal Only', declared:'Connect flow', declaredBy:'You'}, ...st.connectSources],

    this.setState({connectChat:c});
  }
  finalizeModel(c, k, m){
    const checks = ['Recall on held-out set','Precision on held-out set','Calibration check','Fairness slice review','Drift stability','Explainability sample'];
    const outcome = (m.key==='sandbox' || m.key==='import') ? 'awaiting' : m.key==='onprem' ? 'rejected' : 'inservice';
    c.diagnostics=[];
    if(outcome==='rejected'){
      c.status='rejected'; c.stage='done';
      c.rejectReason = checks[2]+' failed on the held-out set.';
      c = this.cPush(c, 'akki', 'Rejected. '+c.name+' failed its acceptance checks \u2014 '+c.rejectReason+' This is a permanent record; it does not retry silently, and a new attempt starts a fresh evaluation.');
      this.setState(st=>({ addedRows:{...st.addedRows, [k.tab]: [{name:c.name, meta:k.label+' \u00b7 '+m.label+' \u00b7 Rejected \u2014 '+c.rejectReason, badgeLabel:'Rejected', badgeBg:'rgba(184,57,91,.12)', badgeColor:'var(--oxblood2)'}].concat(st.addedRows[k.tab]||[])} }));
      this.setToast('Rejected. '+c.name+' did not pass acceptance \u2014 kept on the record.');
    } else if(outcome==='awaiting'){
      c.status='awaiting'; c.stage='done';
      c = this.cPush(c, 'akki', 'All six acceptance checks passed. '+c.name+' is awaiting approval \u2014 it answers nothing real until Approvals \u2192 Model Approval signs it in.');
      this.setState(st=>({ addedRows:{...st.addedRows, [k.tab]: [{name:c.name, meta:k.label+' \u00b7 '+m.label+' \u00b7 6 of 6 checks passed \u00b7 awaiting approval', badgeLabel:'In acceptance', badgeBg:'rgba(176,141,46,.13)', badgeColor:'var(--brass)'}].concat(st.addedRows[k.tab]||[])} }));
      this.setToast('Passed acceptance. '+c.name+' is awaiting approval in Approvals \u2192 Model Approval.');
    } else {
      c.status='inservice'; c.stage='done';
      c = this.cPush(c, 'akki', 'All six acceptance checks passed. Added to '+k.tabName+'. '+c.name+' is in service.');
      this.setState(st=>({ addedRows:{...st.addedRows, [k.tab]: [{name:c.name, meta:k.label+' \u00b7 '+m.label+' \u00b7 6 of 6 checks passed \u00b7 In service', badgeLabel:'In service', badgeBg:'rgba(29,122,110,.12)', badgeColor:'var(--sage)'}].concat(st.addedRows[k.tab]||[])} }));
      this.setToast('In service. '+c.name+' appears in '+k.tabName+'.');
    }
    this.setState({connectChat:c});
  }

    const e=CIR_CLASSES.filter(c=>c.state==='Enforced').length, w=CIR_CLASSES.length-e+filed;
    return (CIR_CLASSES.length+filed)+' classified · '+e+' enforced'+(w? ' · '+w+(w===1?' awaiting signature':' awaiting signatures') : ''); }
  cirAdd = () => this.clsStart();
  clsMatch(text){ const m = CLS_SUGGEST.find(s=>s.re.test(text||''));
    if(m) return m;
    const words=(text||'').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9 ]/g,' ').split(/\s+/).filter(w=>w && !/^(the|a|an|of|and|or|for|our|we|us|all|any|its|it|is|are|that|this|with|about|from|to|in|on|by|records?|data|information|stuff|things?)$/i.test(w)).slice(0,4);
    const name = words.length? words.map((w,i)=> i===0? w.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+w.slice(1).toLowerCase() : w.toLowerCase()).join(' ') : 'Unnamed class';
    return { name, cat:'internal', why:'nothing in what you described points at an identifiable person, so I am reading it as ours to protect rather than the Act\u2019s' }; }
  clsCatLabel(key, named){ const c=CLS_CATS[key];
    return key==='sensitive'? ((named||'A named category')+' \u2014 Kenya DPA sensitive personal data') : c.label; }
  clsBasisDraft(key, named){
    if(key==='sensitive') return 'Confidentiality: high. Disclosure would reveal '+(named||'a named sensitive category').toLowerCase()+' about somebody we can name, and there is no undoing it.\nIntegrity: high. A wrong value here becomes a wrong decision made about a person.\nAvailability: moderate. Service suffers without it; nobody is unsafe.\nBasis in law: '+CLS_CATS[key].cite+'.';
    if(key==='personal') return 'Confidentiality: moderate. Disclosure would expose ordinary details of people we can name and invite misuse.\nIntegrity: high. A wrong value reaches the person as a wrong decision.\nAvailability: moderate. Service degrades without it; nothing unsafe follows.\nBasis in law: '+CLS_CATS[key].cite+'.';
    return 'Confidentiality: high. Disclosure would hand a competitor something we paid to learn.\nIntegrity: moderate. An error misleads our own decisions rather than anyone else\u2019s.\nAvailability: low. Nobody outside is waiting on it.\nBasis in law: '+CLS_CATS[key].cite+'.'; }
  clsPurposeDraft(key){
    if(key==='sensitive') return 'Read only to meet a duty of care to the person the record is about, and only by the roles named on this classification. It may not train a model, leave the estate, or inform a commercial decision.';
    if(key==='personal') return 'Read to deliver and support the service the person asked for, and to answer them when they ask what we hold. It may not be used to profile them or to sell to them.';
    return 'Read by the people doing the work it belongs to. It may not leave Nexus Bank, and it may not reach a third-party application in any form.'; }
  clsStart = () => this.setState({clsOpen:true, clsChat:{ input:'', stage:'describe', a:{}, sug:{}, ed:{}, back:false,
    messages:[{from:'akki', text:'Let\u2019s write a classification. Tell me what this information is, in the words you\u2019d use with a colleague \u2014 I\u2019ll draft the rest and show you every choice before anything is filed.'}] }});

  clsChip(text, jump){ return () => this.clsSay(text, jump); }
  clsSummaryText(){ return 'Here is the whole thing in plain words. What I suggested and you kept is separated from what you changed \u2014 the record keeps that distinction too. Owner and review cadence come from the rule we already agreed; confirm them rather than set them.'; }
  clsSay(text, jump){
    const st=this.state.clsChat;
    let c={...st, messages:st.messages.concat([{from:'you', text}]), input:'', a:{...st.a}, sug:{...st.sug}, ed:{...st.ed}};
    const push=(t)=>{ c.messages=c.messages.concat([{from:'akki', text:t}]); };
    const toSummary=()=>{ c.stage='summary'; c.back=false; push(this.clsSummaryText()); };
    const stage=st.stage;

    if(stage==='describe'){
      const m=this.clsMatch(text);
      c.a.desc=text; c.sug.name=m.name; c.sug.cat=m.cat; c.sug.catWhy=m.why; c.sug.named=m.named||null;
      push('From that I\u2019d call it \u201c'+m.name+'\u201d. Short enough to read on a register, plain enough that nobody has to ask what it means. Does that read right?');
      c.stage='name';
    }
    else if(stage==='name'){
      if(jump==='edit'){ push('Go ahead \u2014 name it the way it should read on the register.'); c.stage='nameEdit'; }
      else if(jump==='accept'){ c.a.name=c.sug.name; this.clsAfterName(c, push, toSummary); }
      else { c.a.name=text; c.ed.name=true; this.clsAfterName(c, push, toSummary); }
    }
    else if(stage==='nameEdit'){
      c.a.name=text; c.ed.name = (text!==c.sug.name);
      this.clsAfterName(c, push, toSummary);
    }
    else if(stage==='category'){
      const key = jump || 'sensitive';
      c.a.cat=key; c.ed.cat = (key!==c.sug.cat);
      if(key==='sensitive' && !c.sug.named) c.sug.named='A named category';
      if(c.back){ toSummary(); }
      else { c.sug.tier=CLS_CATS[key].tier;
        push('Then the tier. I\u2019d put it at '+CLS_CATS[key].tier+'. That comes from ISO 27001 Annex '+CLS_CATS[key].iso+': '+CLS_CATS[key].isoWhy+'. The control that does the enforcing is Annex '+CLS_CATS[key].iso2+'.');
        c.stage='tier'; }
    }
    else if(stage==='tier'){
      const t = jump || CLS_TIERS.find(x=>new RegExp('^'+x,'i').test(text)) || c.sug.tier;
      c.a.tier=t; c.ed.tier = (t!==c.sug.tier);
      if(c.back){ toSummary(); }
      else { const d=this.clsBasisDraft(c.a.cat, c.sug.named); c.sug.basis=d;
        push('Now the basis \u2014 what breaks if this gets out, gets altered, or goes missing, and what law says so. Here is my draft:\n\n'+d+'\n\nKeep it, or edit it and send yours back.');
        c.stage='basis'; c.input=''; }
    }
    else if(stage==='basis'){
      if(jump==='edit'){ push('It\u2019s in the box \u2014 change what is wrong and send it back.'); c.stage='basisEdit'; c.input=c.sug.basis; }
      else if(jump==='accept'){ c.a.basis=c.sug.basis; this.clsAfterBasis(c, push, toSummary); }
      else { c.a.basis=text; c.ed.basis=true; this.clsAfterBasis(c, push, toSummary); }
    }
    else if(stage==='basisEdit'){
      c.a.basis=text; c.ed.basis = (text!==c.sug.basis);
      this.clsAfterBasis(c, push, toSummary);
    }
    else if(stage==='purpose'){
      if(jump==='edit'){ push('Same again \u2014 edit it in the box and send it back.'); c.stage='purposeEdit'; c.input=c.sug.purpose; }
      else if(jump==='accept'){ c.a.purpose=c.sug.purpose; toSummary(); }
      else { c.a.purpose=text; c.ed.purpose=true; toSummary(); }
    }
    else if(stage==='purposeEdit'){
      c.a.purpose=text; c.ed.purpose = (text!==c.sug.purpose); toSummary();
    }
    else if(stage==='summary'){
      if(jump==='file'){ this.clsFile(c, push); }
      else if(jump==='revise'){ push('Which part?'); c.stage='revise'; }
    }
    else if(stage==='revise'){
      c.back=true;
      if(jump==='name'){ push('What should it be called instead?'); c.stage='nameEdit'; }
      else if(jump==='cat'){ push('Pick the category that fits. My read was '+this.clsCatLabel(c.sug.cat, c.sug.named)+' \u2014 because '+c.sug.catWhy+'.'); c.stage='category'; }
      else if(jump==='tier'){ push('Pick the tier. I recommended '+c.sug.tier+', on ISO 27001 Annex '+CLS_CATS[c.a.cat].iso+'.'); c.stage='tier'; }
      else if(jump==='basis'){ push('Here is what is filed now. Edit it in the box and send it back.'); c.stage='basisEdit'; c.input=c.a.basis; }
      else if(jump==='purpose'){ push('Here is what is filed now. Edit it in the box and send it back.'); c.stage='purposeEdit'; c.input=c.a.purpose; }
      else { c.back=false; toSummary(); }
    }
    this.setState({clsChat:c});
  }
  clsAfterName(c, push, toSummary){
    if(c.back){ toSummary(); return; }
    push('Next, where it sits. My read is '+this.clsCatLabel(c.sug.cat, c.sug.named)+' \u2014 because '+c.sug.catWhy+'. Confirm that, or put it somewhere else.');

    this.setToast('Filed for signature.');
  }

      out.push({ ref:'REF-'+(101+i), recId:rec.id, ruleKind:'proposal', mc:'Rule Proposal', cls:'Rule Proposal', userAdded:true, lb:'Maria Chen', at, d:'2026-09-25',

        card2Text:dr[rec.id]||rec.text, reason:rec.reason||'', s1:{n:'Maria Chen', at}, segment:'RS-37'+(10+i), verifiedDate:ad[rec.id] }); });
    (s.clsFiled||[]).forEach((f,i)=>{ const at=this.ruFmt(RU_NOW0,true);
      out.push({ ref:'REF-'+(121+i), ruleKind:'class', mc:'Classification', cls:'Classification', userAdded:true, lb:'Maria Chen', at, d:'2026-09-25', className:f.name,
        text:'\u201c'+f.name+'\u201d is waiting for a signature', state:'Waiting for signature', decl:{category:f.cat, tier:f.tier, owner:f.owner}, s1:{n:'Maria Chen', at}, segment:'RS-38'+(10+i), verifiedDate:'25 Sep 2026' }); });
    (s.ruUserProposals||[]).forEach(p=>out.push(p));
    return out; }
  ruRows(){ const ov=this.state.ruOv||{}, now=this.ruNow(), P=x=>this.chgParse(x), D=x=>String(x||'').split(' at ')[0];
    return GOV_RECORD.overview.rows.concat(this.ruExtraRows()).map(r0=>{ const id=r0.ref||r0.segment; let r=(id&&ov[id])? {...r0, ...ov[id]} : r0;
      if(r.ruleKind==='class' && !r.className) r={...r, className:String(r.text||'').replace(/ (is|are) waiting for a signature$/,'')};
      if(r.state==='Counting down' && r.effect && P(r.effect)<=now){ const tt=P(r.effect), d=D(r.effect);
        r = r.ruleKind==='grant' ? {...r, state:'Granted', resDate:d, resAt:tt, autoDone:true}
          : r.ruleKind==='class' ? {...r, state:'Declared', resDate:d, resAt:tt, autoDone:true}
          : {...r, state:'Enforced', enforced:d, resAt:tt, autoDone:true, rv:r.rv||{date:d, held:true, cert:'CERT-'+String(r.ref||'').replace('REF-','')}}; }
      if(((id&&ov[id]) || r.autoDone) && r.ruleKind!=='listAdd'){
        const ph={'Enforced':'enforced','Granted':'granted','Declined':'declined','Declared':'declared','Cancelled': r.withdrawn?'withdrawn before a second signature':'cancelled before it took effect'}[r.state];
        const txt=String(r.text||'').replace(/ (is|are) (waiting for a (second )?signature|counting down)$/, (m,v)=> r.state==='Counting down'? (' '+v+' counting down') : ph? (' '+(v==='are'?'were ':'was ')+ph) : m);
        if(txt!==r.text) r={...r, text:txt}; }
      return r; }); }
  ruFindRow(id){ return this.ruRows().find(r=>(r.ref||r.segment)===id); }
  ruIsOpen(r){ const k=r.ruleKind; if(!(r.ref||r.segment)) return false;
    if(k==='listAdd') return r.state==='Enforced' && !r.ackBy;
    return /^(proposal|change|listRemove|grant|class)$/.test(k||'') && /^(Waiting for signature|Counting down)$/.test(r.state); }
  ruFiled(r){ return this.chgParse(r.s1? r.s1.at : r.at); }
  ruSortList(w, f){ const P=x=>this.chgParse(x);
    if(f==='next') return w.filter(r=>r.state==='Counting down').sort((a,b)=>P(a.effect)-P(b.effect));
    if(f==='longest') return w.filter(r=>r.state==='Waiting for signature'||r.ruleKind==='listAdd').sort((a,b)=>this.ruFiled(a)-this.ruFiled(b));
    return w.slice().sort((a,b)=>this.ruFiled(b)-this.ruFiled(a)); }
  ruResolved(rows){ const P=x=>this.chgParse(x), D=x=>String(x||'').split(' at ')[0], q=x=>'\u201c'+(x||'')+'\u201d', ov=this.state.ruOv||{}, out=[];
    rows.forEach(r=>{ const k=r.ruleKind, id=r.ref||r.segment; if(!id || !/^(proposal|change|listAdd|listRemove|grant|class)$/.test(k||'')) return;
      if(k==='class' && !(ov[id]||r.autoDone)) return;
      let kind=null, at=0, line='';
      if(k==='listAdd'){ if(!r.ackBy) return; kind='enforced'; at=r.resAt||P(r.ackDate); line='Enforced '+D(r.enforced)+' \u2014 now filed under '+(r.cat||'Managed list')+' \u00b7 re-verified'; }
      else if(r.state==='Enforced'||r.state==='Declared'){ kind='enforced'; at=r.resAt||P(r.enforced||r.resDate); line='Enforced '+D(r.enforced||r.resDate)+' \u2014 now filed under '+(k==='class'?'Classification':(r.cat||''))+' \u00b7 re-verified'; }
      else if(r.state==='Granted'){ kind='granted'; at=r.resAt||P(r.resDate); line='Granted '+r.resDate+' \u2014 access granted \u00b7 seat active'; }
      else if(r.state==='Declined'){ kind='declined'; at=r.resAt||P(r.resDate); line='Declined '+r.resDate+' by '+r.resBy+' \u2014 '+q(r.resReason); }
      else if(r.state==='Cancelled'){ kind='cancelled'; at=r.resAt||P(r.resDate); line='Cancelled '+r.resDate+' by '+r.resBy+' \u2014 '+q(r.resReason); }
      if(kind && at) out.push({r, id, kind, at, line}); });
    return out; }
  ruQuarter(rows){ const now=this.ruNow(), d=new Date(now), qs=new Date(d.getFullYear(), Math.floor(d.getMonth()/3)*3, 1).getTime(), D=x=>String(x||'').split(' at ')[0];
    const list=rows.filter(r=>/^(proposal|change|listAdd|listRemove)$/.test(r.ruleKind||'') && r.d && new Date(r.d+'T00:00:00').getTime()>=qs && /^(Enforced|Counting down|Waiting for signature)$/.test(r.state));
    const en=list.filter(r=>r.state==='Enforced'), cd=list.filter(r=>r.state==='Counting down'), ws=list.filter(r=>r.state==='Waiting for signature');
    const stage=r=> r.state==='Enforced'? 'enforced '+D(r.enforced) : r.state==='Counting down'? 'counting down' : 'awaiting signature';
    const detail=cd.concat(ws, en).slice(0,6).map(r=>this.ruName(r)+' \u2014 '+stage(r)); if(list.length>6) detail.push('and '+(list.length-6)+' more under Changes in the Full Record');
    return { total:list.length, note:en.length+' enforced \u00b7 '+cd.length+' counting down \u00b7 '+ws.length+' awaiting signature', detail }; }
  ruQuarterTile(){ const q=this.ruQuarter(this.ruRows()); return { value:String(q.total), note:q.note, detail:q.detail }; }
  ruSeatStat(rows){ const p=rows.filter(x=>x.ruleKind==='grant' && x.state==='Waiting for signature');
    return { value:String(p.length), note: p.length? (p.map(x=>x.seat? ('a '+x.seat.role+' seat for '+x.seat.who) : this.ruName(x)).join(' and ')+' \u2014 not active until signed') : 'no seat is waiting for a signature',
      detail: p.map(x=>(x.seat? x.seat.who+' \u2014 '+x.seat.role+' seat' : this.ruName(x))+' \u00b7 proposed by '+(x.s1?x.s1.n:x.lb)) }; }
  ruAccessRow(r, rows){ if(!r.ref) return r; const x=rows.find(y=>y.ref===r.ref); if(!x || x.state==='Waiting for signature') return r;
    const base=String(r.text||'').replace(/ is waiting for a second signature$/,'');
    if(x.state==='Counting down'||x.state==='Granted') return {...r, state:'Granted', text:base+' is granted', meta:'Countersigned by '+(x.s2?x.s2.n:'')+' \u00b7 '+(x.state==='Granted'? 'seat active' : 'active when the countdown ends, '+x.effect)};
    if(x.state==='Declined') return {...r, state:'Declined', text:base+' was declined', meta:'Declined '+x.resDate+' by '+x.resBy+' \u2014 \u201c'+(x.resReason||'')+'\u201d'};
    if(x.state==='Cancelled') return {...r, state:'Cancelled', text:base+(x.withdrawn?' was withdrawn':' was cancelled'), meta:(x.withdrawn? 'Withdrawn ' : 'Cancelled ')+x.resDate+' by '+x.resBy+(x.withdrawn? ' \u2014 before a second signature' : '')};
    return r; }
  ruPatch(id, patch){ this.setState(st=>({ ruOv:{...(st.ruOv||{}), [id]:{...((st.ruOv||{})[id]||{}), ...patch}}, ruReasonOpen:null, ruReasonDraft:{...(st.ruReasonDraft||{}), [id]:''} })); }
  ruNotify(to, text, ref){ const at=this.ruFmt(this.ruNow(),true); this.setState(st=>({ruNotes:[{key:'n'+Date.now(), to, text, ref, at}].concat(st.ruNotes||[])})); }
  ruSetRace(id, race){ this.setState(st=>({ruRaced:{...(st.ruRaced||{}), [id]:race}, ruReasonOpen:null})); }
  ruClearRaced(){ const rc=this.state.ruRaced||{}; if(!Object.keys(rc).length) return;
    this.setState(st=>{ const ov={...(st.ruOv||{})}, rr=st.ruRaced||{}; Object.keys(rr).forEach(id=>{ ov[id]={...(ov[id]||{}), ...rr[id].patch}; }); return {ruOv:ov, ruRaced:{}}; }); }
  ruRaceFor(r, action){ const mode=(this.props && this.props.otherSignerActsFirst)||'Off'; if(mode==='Off') return null;
    const v=this.ruViewer(), now=this.ruNow(), at=now-4*60000, tm=this.ruTime(at), L=n=>this.ruLast(n);
    const s1n=r.s1?r.s1.n:(r.lb||''), s2n=r.s2?r.s2.n:'';
    const other=RU_SIGNERS.find(n=>L(n)!==v.last && L(n)!==L(s1n)) || 'L. Achieng';
    if(action==='cancel'){
      if(mode==='The countdown ended first') return { msg:'Already enforced at '+tm+' \u2014 a change now needs a new proposal', patch:{ effect:this.ruFmt(at,true) } };
      const sig = L(s1n)===v.last ? s2n : s1n;
      return { msg:'Already cancelled by '+sig+' at '+tm, patch:{ state:'Cancelled', resDate:this.ruFmt(at), resBy:sig, resReason:'Cancelled during the countdown.', resAt:at } }; }
    if(mode!=='Another signer acted first') return null;
    const patch={ state:'Counting down', s2:{n:other, at:this.ruFmt(at,true)}, effect:this.ruFmt(at+72*3600000,true) };
    if(action==='withdraw') return { msg:'Already countersigned by '+other+' at '+tm+' \u2014 it is now counting down; cancel it from there.', patch };
    return { msg:'Already countersigned by '+other+' at '+tm, patch }; }
  ruApprove(id){ return () => { const r=this.ruFindRow(id), v=this.ruViewer(); if(!r || v.isOp || r.state!=='Waiting for signature') return;
    const race=this.ruRaceFor(r,'approve'); if(race){ this.ruSetRace(id, race); return; }
    const now=this.ruNow(); this.ruPatch(id, {state:'Counting down', s2:{n:v.name, at:this.ruFmt(now,true)}, effect:this.ruFmt(now+(r.countdownHrs||72)*3600000,true)});
    this.setToast(r.ruleKind==='grant' ? 'Countersigned. The seat reads granted in Trust Center; the countdown runs before it is active.' : 'Countersigned. The countdown has started \u2014 cancellable until it applies.'); }; }
  ruAcknowledge(id){ return () => { const r=this.ruFindRow(id), v=this.ruViewer(); if(!r || v.isOp || this.ruLast(r.lb)===v.last) return;
    const now=this.ruNow(); this.ruPatch(id, {ackBy:v.name, ackDate:this.ruFmt(now), resAt:now}); this.setToast('Acknowledged. The Full Record shows who and when.'); }; }
  ruConfirmReason(id){ return () => { const st=this.state, reason=((st.ruReasonDraft||{})[id]||'').trim(); if(!reason) return;
    const r=this.ruFindRow(id), v=this.ruViewer(); if(!r || v.isOp) return; const now=this.ruNow(), L=n=>this.ruLast(n);
    const isNS=r.state==='Waiting for signature', mine=L(r.s1&&r.s1.n)===v.last, action=isNS? (mine?'withdraw':'decline') : 'cancel';
    const race=this.ruRaceFor(r, action); if(race){ this.ruSetRace(id, race); return; }
    const base={resDate:this.ruFmt(now), resBy:v.name, resReason:reason, resAt:now};
    if(action==='decline'){ this.ruPatch(id,{...base, state:'Declined'}); this.setToast('Declined. The reason is on the record.'); return; }
    if(action==='withdraw'){ this.ruPatch(id,{...base, state:'Cancelled', withdrawn:true});
      this.ruNotify(RU_SIGNERS.filter(n=>L(n)!==v.last), v.name+' withdrew the proposal '+id+' \u2014 \u201c'+reason+'\u201d', id);
      this.setToast('Withdrawn. The record keeps it, marked cancelled.'); return; }
    this.ruPatch(id,{...base, state:'Cancelled'});
    const other = L(r.s1&&r.s1.n)===v.last ? (r.s2&&r.s2.n) : (r.s1&&r.s1.n);
    if(other) this.ruNotify([other], v.name+' cancelled the change to '+id+' \u2014 \u201c'+reason+'\u201d', id);
    this.setToast('Cancelled. Nothing took effect'+(other? '; '+other+' has been told.' : '.')); }; }
  _ruScrollTo(ref){ if(typeof document==='undefined' || !ref) return; const el=document.querySelector('[data-ru-card="'+ref+'"]'); if(!el) return;
    let p=el.parentElement; while(p && p!==document.body && p!==document.documentElement){ const oy=getComputedStyle(p).overflowY; if((oy==='auto'||oy==='scroll') && p.scrollHeight>p.clientHeight+2) break; p=p.parentElement; }
    const top=el.getBoundingClientRect().top;
    if(p && p!==document.body && p!==document.documentElement) p.scrollTop += top - p.getBoundingClientRect().top - 24; else window.scrollBy(0, top-24); }
  ruArrive(ref){ this.ruClearRaced(); const list=this.ruSortList(this.ruRows().filter(r=>this.ruIsOpen(r)),'all');
    const i=ref? list.findIndex(r=>(r.ref||r.segment)===ref) : -1, page=i>=0? Math.floor(i/10)+1 : 1;
    this.setState({dw:null, navTab:'admin'}); this.appNav('rulesupd')(); this.setState({ruFilter:'all', ruPage:page, ruReasonOpen:null, ruFlash: i>=0? ref : null});
    if(i>=0){ [90,320,750,1400].forEach(ms=>setTimeout(()=>this._ruScrollTo(ref), ms)); clearTimeout(this._ruFlashT); this._ruFlashT=setTimeout(()=>this.setState({ruFlash:null}), 3200); } }
  ruOpenInShield(ref){ return () => { this.ruClearRaced(); const row=this.ruRows().find(r=>(r.ref||r.segment)===ref);

  proposeSignersLeft(){ const v=this.ruViewer(); return RU_SIGNERS.filter(n=>this.ruLast(n)!==v.last); }
  proposeCatFor(text){ const t=(text||'').toLowerCase();
    if(/security|seat|probe|contain|watch/.test(t)) return 'Security';
    if(/regulat|dpa|kra|cbk|law/.test(t)) return 'Regulatory';
    if(/model|llm|answer|evidence|cite|hedge|claim/.test(t)) return 'LLM Interaction';
    if(/gate|system/.test(t)) return 'System Gates';
    return 'Confidential Data'; }
  proposeIsDeclaration(text){ return /\b(confidential|classify|classification|declare|declared)\b/i.test(text||''); }
  proposeIsHardLine(text){ return /\bnever\b|\balways\b|\bno exception|\bunder no circumstances\b/i.test(text||''); }
  proposeCountdownFor(a){ const t=((a.sentence||'')+' '+(a.reason||'')).toLowerCase();
    if(a.category==='Security') return {hrs:168, label:'7 days \u2014 touches the security service\u2019s own rules'};
    if(/tighten|restrict|reduce|remove|lower|narrow|revoke/.test(t)) return {hrs:24, label:'24 hours \u2014 tightening'};
    return {hrs:72, label:'72 hours \u2014 standard loosening'}; }
  proposeOpenCheck = () => { const left=this.proposeSignersLeft();

    this.setState({proposeOpen:true, proposeStage:'describe', proposeInput:'', proposeConfirmClose:false,
      proposeAnswers:{sentence:'', category:'', binding:'', reason:'', countdownHrs:72, countdownLabel:'72 hours \u2014 standard loosening'},

    const row={ ref:'REF-'+(181+n), ruleKind:'proposal', mc:'Rule Proposal', cls:'Rule Proposal', userAdded:true, lb:v.name, at, d:'2026-09-25',

  ruCardView(r, v, now){ const s=this.state, id=r.ref||r.segment, k=r.ruleKind, DAY=86400000, P=x=>this.chgParse(x), D=x=>String(x||'').split(' at ')[0], L=n=>this.ruLast(n);
    const isAdd=k==='listAdd', isCD=r.state==='Counting down', isNS=r.state==='Waiting for signature';
    const s1n=r.s1?r.s1.n:(r.lb||''), s2n=r.s2?r.s2.n:'';
    const mineNS=isNS && L(s1n)===v.last, mineCD=isCD && (L(s1n)===v.last || L(s2n)===v.last), mineAdd=isAdd && L(r.lb)===v.last;
    const race=(s.ruRaced||{})[id];
    const kindLabel=k==='grant'?'Seat grant':(k==='change'||k==='listRemove')?'Rule change':'Rule proposal';
    const subline = k==='change'? ('Current wording: '+(r.card1Text||'')+' \u2192 proposed above.') : k==='listRemove'? ('Removes: '+(r.entry||'')) : isAdd? ('Added: '+(r.entry||'')) : '';
    const meta = isAdd ? ('Managed list \u00b7 Added by '+r.lb+' \u00b7 '+r.at+' \u00b7 in force since '+(r.inForce||r.at))
      : (kindLabel+' \u00b7 Proposed by '+s1n+' \u00b7 '+D(r.s1?r.s1.at:r.at)+(s2n? ' \u00b7 Countersigned by '+s2n : ''));

function journalDisplay(slug){
  const dot = slug.lastIndexOf('.');
  const base = dot>0? slug.slice(0,dot) : slug;
  const ext = dot>0? slug.slice(dot) : '';
  return base.replace(/[-_]+/g,' ').replace(/\b\w/g, c=>c.toUpperCase()) + ext;
}

function censusFmtDateTime(ts){ const d = new Date(ts); return d.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'short',day:'numeric',year:'numeric'}) + ', ' + d.toLocaleTimeString('en-US',{hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit'}); }
function censusFmtDuration(ms){ const totalSec = Math.max(0,Math.round(ms/1000)); const m = Math.floor(totalSec/60), s = totalSec%60; return m>0 ? (m+'m '+s+'s') : (s+'s'); }
function censusChip(deltaStr, riseColor){
  if(!deltaStr || deltaStr==='\u2014') return {show:false, text:'', color:''};
  const rising = /^\+/.test(deltaStr) && !/^\+0(\s|$)/.test(deltaStr);
  const text = (rising? '\u2191 ' : '') + deltaStr.replace(/^\+/,'');
  return {show:true, text, color: rising? riseColor : 'var(--ink3)'};
}
function censusRelDays(ts){ const days = Math.round((ts-Date.now())/86400000); if(days===0) return 'today'; if(days===1) return 'in 1 day'; if(days>1) return 'in '+days+' days'; if(days===-1) return '1 day ago'; return Math.abs(days)+' days ago'; }
